2981.summary_md: The fragrant tree is no ordinary tree, and Michael says so: *And as for this fragrant tree no mortal is permitted to touch it till the great judgement, when He shall take vengeance on all and bring (everything) to its consummation for ever. It shall then be given to the righteous and holy. Its fruit shall be for food to the elect: it shall be transplanted to the holy place, to the temple of Yahuah (Lord), the Eternal King.* (1 Enoch 25:4-5). This is Eden's own tree, the one Yahuah planted *pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden* (Genesis 2:9), and then sealed from mortal reach so that no man should *take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever* (Genesis 3:22). Enoch sees the same fruit given back to the elect at the end, and that is exactly the promise Yahusha (Jesus) makes to the overcomer: *To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of Elohim (God).* (Revelation 2:7). He shows it again standing in the City: *In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.* (Revelation 22:2). Ezekiel saw it too, growing by the water that comes out from under the sanctuary: *And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.* (Ezekiel 47:12). The tree withheld since Eden is the tree given to the righteous after the judgement, and the holy place is where it is given.
2981.note: old 29:10-11 was a paraphrase of 25:4-5 from the corrupt text; re-quoted from the live verses in full; canon kept

2982.title: Transplanted to the temple: long life and no more sorrow
2982.summary_md: The tree's destiny is the sanctuary, and the destiny of the elect is life beside it: *Its fruit shall be for food to the elect: it shall be transplanted to the holy place, to the temple of Yahuah (Lord), the Eternal King. Then shall they rejoice with joy and be glad, And into the holy place shall they enter; And its fragrance shall be in their bones, And they shall live a long life on earth, Such as thy fathers lived: And in their days shall no sorrow or plague Or torment or calamity touch them.’* (1 Enoch 25:5-6). This is the prophets' restored earth, where the days of the people are measured like the days of a tree: *They shall not build, and another inhabit; they shall not plant, and another eat: for as the days of a tree are the days of my people, and mine elect shall long enjoy the work of their hands.* (Isaiah 65:22). The end of sorrow and plague and torment that Enoch names is the same comfort the prophets and the Revelation give: *He will swallow up death in victory; and Adonai Yahuah (the Lord GOD) will wipe away tears from off all faces; and the rebuke of his people shall he take away from off all the earth: for Yahuah (LORD) hath spoken it.* (Isaiah 25:8), unfolded at the end as *And Elohim (God) shall wipe away all tears from their eyes; and there shall be no more death, neither sorrow, nor crying, neither shall there be any more pain: for the former things are passed away.* (Revelation 21:4). The right to enter the holy place and eat is kept for those who keep the way: *Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.* (Revelation 22:14). Enoch says the fathers lived such a life once; the prophets say the elect will live it again.
2982.note: old 29:11-12 was 25:5-6 under the wrong number; re-cited and quoted in full

2983.title: The fragrant trees of the east — the chief spices
2983.summary_md: Past the valley of water Enoch walks through country that smells like the sanctuary: *And on the sides of those valleys I saw fragrant cinnamon. And beyond these I proceeded to the east.* (1 Enoch 30:3), then *And I saw other mountains, and amongst them were groves of trees, and there flowed forth from them nectar, which is named sarara and galbanum. And beyond these mountains I saw another mountain to the east of the ends of the earth, whereon were aloe-trees, and all the trees were full of stacte, being like almond-trees. And when one burnt it, it smelt sweeter than any fragrant odour.* (1 Enoch 31:1-3), and north of these, *And after these fragrant odours, as I looked towards the north over the mountains I saw seven mountains full of choice nard and fragrant trees and cinnamon and pepper.* (1 Enoch 32:1). Cinnamon, nectar, galbanum, stacte, aloes, nard — these are the spices Yahuah (LORD) set apart for His own house. The incense of the holy place is compounded from the same list: *Take unto thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; these sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight* (Exodus 30:34), and the anointing oil from the rest of it: *Take thou also unto thee principal spices, of pure myrrh five hundred shekels, and of sweet cinnamon half so much, even two hundred and fifty shekels, and of sweet calamus two hundred and fifty shekels,* (Exodus 30:23). The Song gathers them into the Bridegroom's garden: *Spikenard and saffron; calamus and cinnamon, with all trees of frankincense; myrrh and aloes, with all the chief spices:* (Song of Solomon 4:14). Enoch's eastern mountains are growing the very things the Torah later tells the priests to burn before Yahuah (LORD). The sanctuary smells like the garden because the garden came first.
2983.note: old 30:1-2 quotes (styrax, onycha, balsam) are not in Charles; rebuilt on the live 30:3, 31:1-3, 32:1; canon kept, Exodus 30:34 added from the old 31 thread

2984.title: The tree of wisdom — Eden's tree of knowledge
2984.summary_md: At the Garden of Righteousness Enoch finds one tree set apart from the rest: *And I came to the Garden of Righteousness, and saw beyond those trees many large trees growing there and of goodly fragrance, large, very beautiful and glorious, and the tree of wisdom whereof they eat and know great wisdom. That tree is in height like the fir, and its leaves are like (those of) the Carob tree: and its fruit is like the clusters of the vine, very beautiful: and the fragrance of the tree penetrates afar.* (1 Enoch 32:3-4). He asks about it, and the angel names it: *Then Raphael the holy angel, who was with me, answered me and said: ‘This is the tree of wisdom, of which thy father old (in years) and thy aged mother, who were before thee, have eaten, and they learnt wisdom and their eyes were opened, and they knew that they were naked and they were driven out of the garden.’* (1 Enoch 32:6). This is Eden's own tree, the one Genesis sets *in the midst of the garden*: *And out of the ground made Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.* (Genesis 2:9). Enoch's phrase *they learnt wisdom* is Eve's reach for it: *And when the woman saw that the tree was good for food, and that it was pleasant to the eyes, and a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof, and did eat, and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat.* (Genesis 3:6). And *their eyes were opened, and they knew that they were naked* is the fall told in Moses' own words: *And the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked; and they sewed fig leaves together, and made themselves aprons.* (Genesis 3:7). So is the driving out: *So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life.* (Genesis 3:24). Raphael is reading Genesis 2 and 3 to Enoch, naming the tree of knowledge by its fruit and by what it cost, with the way back still guarded until the appointed day.
2984.note: old 30:7 was 32:6 under the wrong number; re-cited, 32:3-4 added so the reader sees the tree before the naming

2985.title: The tree transplanted to the temple — fruit for the righteous
2985.summary_md: The tree withheld from Adam is not destroyed. It is kept: *And as for this fragrant tree no mortal is permitted to touch it till the great judgement, when He shall take vengeance on all and bring (everything) to its consummation for ever. It shall then be given to the righteous and holy. Its fruit shall be for food to the elect: it shall be transplanted to the holy place, to the temple of Yahuah (Lord), the Eternal King. Then shall they rejoice with joy and be glad, And into the holy place shall they enter; And its fragrance shall be in their bones, And they shall live a long life on earth, Such as thy fathers lived: And in their days shall no sorrow or plague Or torment or calamity touch them.’* (1 Enoch 25:4-6). John sees the same tree replanted at the centre of the renewed city: *In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.* (Revelation 22:2), and only the covenant-keepers come to it: *Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city.* (Revelation 22:14). Ezekiel sets the same healing trees along the water that flows from the sanctuary: *And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.* (Ezekiel 47:12). The tree denied at the fall is carried to the temple-mountain at the judgement and its fruit goes to the elect who keep the way. That is a restoration of the covenant people at the centre, not a replacement of them, and Enoch saw it before Ezekiel or John did.
2985.note: old quoted 30:8-10 and 24:11, none of which exist in Charles; the live 25:4-6 carries the whole thought; canon kept

2986.title: The fragrant trees — frankincense and myrrh
2986.summary_md: East of the mountain range Enoch comes to trees that breathe the incense of worship: *And thence I went to another place in the desert, and approached to the east of this mountain range. And there I saw aromatic trees exhaling the fragrance of frankincense and myrrh, and the trees also were similar to the almond tree.* (1 Enoch 29:1-2), and beyond them, *And beyond these mountains I saw another mountain to the east of the ends of the earth, whereon were aloe-trees, and all the trees were full of stacte, being like almond-trees. And when one burnt it, it smelt sweeter than any fragrant odour.* (1 Enoch 31:2-3). Frankincense and myrrh are the fragrances Yahuah (LORD) reserves for His sanctuary: *Take unto thee sweet spices, stacte, and onycha, and galbanum; these sweet spices with pure frankincense: of each shall there be a like weight* (Exodus 30:34). They are the same smoke that goes up around the Bridegroom as He comes out of the wilderness: *Who is this that cometh out of the wilderness like pillars of smoke, perfumed with myrrh and frankincense, with all powders of the merchant?* (Song of Solomon 3:6). Enoch says that when the aloe was burnt it smelt sweeter than any fragrant odour, and that is a man describing incense before Moses was told how to compound it. The trees of the east were worship trees from the start.
2986.note: old 31:1 and 31:3 are not in Charles; the live 29:1-2 and 31:2-3 carry frankincense, myrrh, and the burning; canon kept

2987.title: The tree of wisdom — eyes opened, driven from the garden
2987.summary_md: The angel names the tree for Enoch: *Then Raphael the holy angel, who was with me, answered me and said: ‘This is the tree of wisdom, of which thy father old (in years) and thy aged mother, who were before thee, have eaten, and they learnt wisdom and their eyes were opened, and they knew that they were naked and they were driven out of the garden.’* (1 Enoch 32:6). This is Eden retold without a seam. Eve saw *a tree to be desired to make one wise, she took of the fruit thereof... and gave also unto her husband with her; and he did eat* (Genesis 3:6); then *the eyes of them both were opened, and they knew that they were naked* (Genesis 3:7); and Yahuah Elohim *sent him forth from the garden of Eden, to till the ground from whence he was taken* (Genesis 3:23). Enoch is shown the very tree Genesis names, standing where it stood, still bearing. The order Yahuah set in the garden was good; the fall was a reach for wisdom apart from the Creator's way, and the command that was broken was never the thing at fault.
2987.note: old 31:4 was 32:6 under the wrong number; re-cited

2988.title: The tree reserved for the elect — transplanted to the holy place
2988.summary_md: The tree Michael shows Enoch is sealed off until the day of reckoning and then given back to the righteous: *And as for this fragrant tree no mortal is permitted to touch it till the great judgement, when He shall take vengeance on all and bring (everything) to its consummation for ever. It shall then be given to the righteous and holy. Its fruit shall be for food to the elect: it shall be transplanted to the holy place, to the temple of Yahuah (Lord), the Eternal King.* (1 Enoch 25:4-5). This is the Eden tree carried home to the mountain of the house. Ezekiel sees it rooted by the sanctuary stream: *shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed... because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine* (Ezekiel 47:12); Revelation sets it in the City: *the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits... and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations* (Revelation 22:2); and the way in is for those who keep the covenant: *Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city* (Revelation 22:14). The vengeance falls on all who earned it, the fruit goes to the righteous and holy, and the tree is planted again at the centre. Eden, the mountain of the house, and the age to come are one story told three times.
2988.note: old 31:5-6 were paraphrases of 25:4-5 under invented numbers; re-quoted from the live verses; canon kept

2990.title: Driven out — the tree of wisdom and the way kept
2990.summary_md: Of the tree their parents ate from Enoch is told the end of the matter: *Then Raphael the holy angel, who was with me, answered me and said: ‘This is the tree of wisdom, of which thy father old (in years) and thy aged mother, who were before thee, have eaten, and they learnt wisdom and their eyes were opened, and they knew that they were naked and they were driven out of the garden.’* (1 Enoch 32:6). Genesis gives the reason for the driving out, that fallen man should not seize life for ever: *And Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) said, Behold, the man is become as one of us, to know good and evil: and now, lest he put forth his hand, and take also of the tree of life, and eat, and live for ever* (Genesis 3:22), and it names the guard set at the gate: *So he drove out the man; and he placed at the east of the garden of Eden Cherubims, and a flaming sword which turned every way, to keep the way of the tree of life* (Genesis 3:24). Enoch, standing in the Garden of Righteousness with the tree of wisdom in front of him, is being shown that the garden is still there and the way is still kept. What Raphael says of this tree matches what Michael said of the other: *And as for this fragrant tree no mortal is permitted to touch it till the great judgement, when He shall take vengeance on all and bring (everything) to its consummation for ever. It shall then be given to the righteous and holy.* (1 Enoch 25:4). The bar was never on wisdom itself. It was on wisdom taken against the command, and the righteous wait for the great judgement, when the way is opened again.
2990.note: old 32:6-7 ran the 32:6 words into a sentence Charles does not have; rebuilt on 32:6 with 25:4 beside it; Proverbs 3:18 dropped (not in the verse index)

2991.title: The fruit given to the righteous — transplanted to the temple
2991.summary_md: At the great judgement Enoch's tree is opened to the elect and moved to the holy place: *And as for this fragrant tree no mortal is permitted to touch it till the great judgement, when He shall take vengeance on all and bring (everything) to its consummation for ever. It shall then be given to the righteous and holy. Its fruit shall be for food to the elect: it shall be transplanted to the holy place, to the temple of Yahuah (Lord), the Eternal King. Then shall they rejoice with joy and be glad, And into the holy place shall they enter; And its fragrance shall be in their bones, And they shall live a long life on earth, Such as thy fathers lived: And in their days shall no sorrow or plague Or torment or calamity touch them.’* (1 Enoch 25:4-6). A tree of Eden standing in a holy place is the prophets' own picture, because Eden was always the garden of Elohim (God): *Thou hast been in Eden the garden of Elohim (God); every precious stone was thy covering, the sardius, topaz, and the diamond, the beryl, the onyx, and the jasper, the sapphire, the emerald, and the carbuncle, and gold: the workmanship of thy tabrets and of thy pipes was prepared in thee in the day that thou wast created* (Ezekiel 28:13). Yahusha (Jesus) gives the same promise to the overcomer: *He that hath an ear, let him hear what the Spirit saith unto the churches; To him that overcometh will I give to eat of the tree of life, which is in the midst of the paradise of Elohim (God)* (Revelation 2:7), and Revelation sets the tree at the throne in the holy city: *In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations* (Revelation 22:2), with its right reserved for the commandment-keepers: *Blessed are they that do his commandments, that they may have right to the tree of life, and may enter in through the gates into the city* (Revelation 22:14). 2 Esdras hears the same opening: *For to you is paradise opened, the tree of life is planted, the time to come is prepared, plenteousness is made ready, a city is builded, and rest is allowed, yes, perfect goodness and wisdom* (2 Esdras 8:52). The fruit is for the elect who keep the way, and the tree is carried to the temple of Yahuah (Lord) at the centre.
2991.note: old 32:8-9 was 25:5-6 under the wrong number; re-quoted in full; canon kept

2993.title: The stars come forth in their order — the courses Enoch wrote down
2993.summary_md: At the eastern ends of the earth Enoch watches the host come out through its gates: *And to the east of those beasts I saw the ends of the earth whereon the heaven rests, and the portals of the heaven open. And I saw how the stars of heaven come forth, and I counted the portals out of which they proceed, and wrote down all their outlets, of each individual star by itself, according to their number and their names, their courses and their positions, and their times and their months, as Uriel the holy angel who was with me showed me.* (1 Enoch 33:2-3), and *He showed all things to me and wrote them down for me: also their names he wrote for me, and their laws and their companies.* (1 Enoch 33:4). The stars have courses and times and laws, and Uriel had them written. This is the lesson Enoch opens the whole book with: *Observe ye everything that takes place in the heaven, how they do not change their orbits, and the luminaries which are in the heaven, how they all rise and set in order each in its season, and transgress not against their appointed order.* (1 Enoch 2:1). He had already seen what turns them: *I saw the winds of heaven which turn and bring the circumference of the sun and all the stars to their setting.* (1 Enoch 18:4). The Tanakh reads the same fidelity in the heavens: *He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.* (Psalm 104:19), and the Creator alone holds the reins of the constellations — *Canst thou bind the sweet influences of Pleiades, or loose the bands of Orion?* (Job 38:31), *Canst thou bring forth Mazzaroth in his season? or canst thou guide Arcturus with his sons?* (Job 38:32). The stars that never break rank are Enoch's standing rebuke to the ones that did, for he was shown their prison on the same journey: *And the stars which roll over the fire are they which have transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (Lord) in the beginning of their rising, because they did not come forth at their appointed times.* (1 Enoch 18:15). The heavens keep the order they were given, and rebellion against the appointed courses is where the trouble began.
2993.note: old 33:5 and 33:7 are not in Charles; the live 33:2-4, 18:4 and 18:15 carry the thought; canon kept

2994.title: The great beasts and birds at the ends of the earth — the Creator's works kept
2994.summary_md: Before Enoch reaches the gates of heaven he passes the creatures that live at the edge of the world: *And from thence I went to the ends of the earth and saw there great beasts, and each differed from the other; and (I saw) birds also differing in appearance and beauty and voice, the one differing from the other.* (1 Enoch 33:1). Then the gates: *And to the east of those beasts I saw the ends of the earth whereon the heaven rests, and the portals of the heaven open.* (1 Enoch 33:2). Every kind differs from every other kind, and Enoch counts them as he counts the stars, each one by itself. That is Genesis speaking, every creature after its kind, and the man set over them to name them. Enoch is doing the work Adam was given, writing down names and courses and kinds under an angel's instruction. The fragrant tree he had smelt on the throne-mountain belongs to the same ordered creation: *And amongst them was a tree such as I had never yet smelt, neither was any amongst them nor were others like it: it had a fragrance beyond all fragrance, and its leaves and blooms and wood wither not for ever: and its fruit is beautiful, and its fruit resembles the dates of a palm.* (1 Enoch 24:4). And the tree that wither not is the one Ezekiel sees by the sanctuary stream — *And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.* (Ezekiel 47:12) — and the one John is shown at the end: *In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.* (Revelation 22:2). What Enoch sees at the ends of the earth and what he smelt on the mountain are one creation, kept in order and kept for the righteous.
2994.note: old 33:10 (trees of paradise at the north) is not in Charles 33; rebuilt on the live 33:1-2 with the 24:4 tree kept; Genesis 2:9 dropped since the live chapter has no paradise; title changed

2995.title: The treasuries of the winds — He ordered all creation by His wisdom
2995.summary_md: Enoch is shown where the winds are kept and what they do: *I saw the treasuries of all the winds: I saw how He had furnished with them the whole creation and the firm foundations of the earth. And I saw the corner-stone of the earth: I saw the four winds which bear [the earth and] the firmament of the heaven.* (1 Enoch 18:1-2). At the ends of the earth he sees the gates they come through: *And here I saw three portals of heaven open in the heaven: through each of them proceed north winds: when they blow there is cold, hail, frost, snow, dew, and rain. And out of one portal they blow for good: but when they blow through the other two portals, it is with violence and affliction on the earth, and they blow with violence.* (1 Enoch 34:2-3). These are the very treasuries Yahuah (LORD) set before Job out of the whirlwind — *Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,* (Job 38:22) — and the prophets confess the wind drawn out of the same store: *He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.* (Psalm 135:7), *When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.* (Jeremiah 10:13). Jeremiah names the wisdom behind the store in the verse before: *He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heavens by his discretion.* (Jeremiah 10:12). The world is not loose. It is furnished, founded, and ordered by the One who weighs the snow and appoints the seasons, and Enoch saw the furnishing.
2995.note: old 33:11-12 are not in Charles 33; the live 18:1-2 and 34:2-3 carry the treasuries; Proverbs 8:22 dropped (not in the index), Jeremiah 10:12 added from the index

2997.title: The four winds that bear the earth — the four quarters
2997.summary_md: Having walked north, east, south, and west, Enoch has seen the whole frame of the world at its corners, and on the earlier journey he had already seen what holds it: *And I saw the corner-stone of the earth: I saw the four winds which bear [the earth and] the firmament of the heaven.* (1 Enoch 18:2). The four winds are a fixed feature of the prophets' visions. Daniel watches them stir the nations: *Daniel spake and said, I saw in my vision by night, and, behold, the four winds of the heaven strove upon the great sea.* (Daniel 7:2). John sees angels set over them, held back until the sealing is done: *And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.* (Revelation 7:1). Enoch's own book of the luminaries names the quarters one by one: *And the first quarter is called the east, because it is the first: and the second, the south, because the El Elyon (Most High) will descend there, yea, there in quite a special sense will He who is blessed for ever descend. And the west quarter is named the diminished, because there all the luminaries of the heaven wane and go down.* (1 Enoch 77:1-2). The earth ordered to four corners, with winds held or loosed at the Creator's word, is the architecture Daniel and John take for granted, and Enoch is the one who wrote it down first.
2997.note: old 34:6 is not in Charles 34; the live 18:2 and 77:1-2 carry the four winds and quarters; canon kept

2998.title: The winds that bear the earth — the pillars of heaven
2998.summary_md: Enoch is shown the frame of the cosmos and what holds it up: *And I saw the corner-stone of the earth: I saw the four winds which bear [the earth and] the firmament of the heaven. And I saw how the winds stretch out the vaults of heaven, and have their station between heaven and earth: these are the pillars of the heaven.* (1 Enoch 18:2-3). The canon speaks the same architecture. Job knows both the hung earth and the trembling pillars: *He stretcheth out the north over the empty place, and hangeth the earth upon nothing.* (Job 26:7), *The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.* (Job 26:11). Isaiah sees the heavens stretched out like a tent — *It is he that sitteth upon the circle of the earth, and the inhabitants thereof are as grasshoppers; that stretcheth out the heavens as a curtain, and spreadeth them out as a tent to dwell in:* (Isaiah 40:22) — and the Psalm makes the very winds His servants: *Who maketh his angels spirits; his ministers a flaming fire:* (Psalm 104:4). Enoch's pillars and stretched-out vaults are the picture the canon already carries, a heaven the Creator hangs, spreads, and upholds, with the winds standing at their station to do it.
2998.note: old 34:7-8 were 18:2-3 under the wrong numbers; re-cited; canon kept

2999.title: The west portals and the storehouses of wind, dew, and rain
2999.summary_md: Enoch comes to the western edge and finds the same ordered gates he had seen in the east: *And from thence I went towards the west to the ends of the earth, and saw there three portals of the heaven open such as I had seen in the east, the same number of portals, and the same number of outlets.* (1 Enoch 35:1). What comes through such gates he had just been shown on the north side: *And here I saw three portals of heaven open in the heaven: through each of them proceed north winds: when they blow there is cold, hail, frost, snow, dew, and rain. And out of one portal they blow for good: but when they blow through the other two portals, it is with violence and affliction on the earth, and they blow with violence.* (1 Enoch 34:2-3), and on the south: *And from thence I went to the south to the ends of the earth, and saw there three open portals of the heaven: and thence there come dew, rain, and wind.* (1 Enoch 36:1). The wind comes as gift and as affliction, and both are sent, not loosed. The Tanakh already keeps wind and weather in named storehouses that Yahuah (LORD) opens at His word: *He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries.* (Psalms 135:7); *When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures.* (Jeremiah 10:13); and the same storehouses hold the frost and hail Enoch names — *Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail,* (Job 38:22). This is the Creator's order, and Enoch is shown it gate by gate, so that the reader can tell it apart from the disorder the Watchers brought.
2999.note: old 35:2 and 35:8 are not in Charles 35 (which has one verse); the live 34:2-3 and 36:1 carry the winds through the gates; canon kept

3000.title: The four quarters of the earth and the four winds
3000.summary_md: From the western edge Enoch has now seen all four sides of the world, and he had already been shown what divides it: *And I saw the corner-stone of the earth: I saw the four winds which bear [the earth and] the firmament of the heaven.* (1 Enoch 18:2). The four winds and four quarters are the standard furniture of the prophets. Daniel watches them stir the nations: *Daniel spake and said, I saw in my vision by night, and, behold, the four winds of the heaven strove upon the great sea.* (Daniel 7:2). Zechariah is told the four chariot-spirits are the same: *And the angel answered and said unto me, These are the four spirits of the heavens, which go forth from standing before Yahuah (Lord) of all the earth.* (Zechariah 6:5). John sees them held back at the corners: *And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.* (Revelation 7:1). And Yahusha (Jesus) gathers the scattered seed from these same four winds at the end: *And he shall send his angels with a great sound of a trumpet, and they shall gather together his elect from the four winds, from one end of heaven to the other.* (Matthew 24:31). The four quarters Enoch surveys are the compass the elect of Yashar'el (Israel) are gathered home from.
3000.note: old 35:5 is not in Charles 35; the live 18:2 carries the four winds; canon kept

3001.title: The pillars of heaven and the stretched-out firmament
3001.summary_md: Enoch sees the winds themselves doing the structural work of holding the world up: *And I saw the corner-stone of the earth: I saw the four winds which bear [the earth and] the firmament of the heaven. And I saw how the winds stretch out the vaults of heaven, and have their station between heaven and earth: these are the pillars of the heaven.* (1 Enoch 18:2-3). The Tanakh names these pillars and the firmament they bear. Job knows the heavens rest on pillars that tremble at a word: *The pillars of heaven tremble and are astonished at his reproof.* (Job 26:11), and Hannah sings that the earth's foundations are Yahuah's own setting: *He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill, to set them among princes, and to make them inherit the throne of glory: for the pillars of the earth are the LORD'S, and he hath set the world upon them.* (1 Samuel 2:8). The firmament Enoch sees stretched is the firmament of the second day: *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be a firmament in the midst of the waters, and let it divide the waters from the waters.* (Genesis 1:6). And when the journey is over Enoch says plainly whose work it all is: *And as often as I saw I blessed always Yahuah (Lord) of Glory, and I continued to bless Yahuah (Lord) of Glory who has wrought great and glorious wonders, to show the greatness of His work to the angels and to spirits and to men, that they might praise His work and all His creation: that they might see the work of His might and praise the great work of His hands and bless Him for ever.* (1 Enoch 36:4). The whole survey is creation kept in the Creator's order, the opposite of the disorder the Watchers brought into it.
3001.note: old 35:6-7 were 18:2-3 under the wrong numbers and 36:9 is not in Charles; re-cited, 36:4 quoted for the close; canon kept

3002.title: The portals of heaven and the four winds
3002.summary_md: Enoch finishes the circuit at the south and the east: *And from thence I went to the south to the ends of the earth, and saw there three open portals of the heaven: and thence there come dew, rain, and wind. And from thence I went to the east to the ends of the heaven, and saw here the three eastern portals of heaven open and small portals above them. Through each of these small portals pass the stars of heaven and run their course to the west on the path which is shown to them.* (1 Enoch 36:1-3). The stars run their course on a path that is shown to them, and the winds come through gates that are counted. John sees the same four-cornered order held in place in the last days: *And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree.* (Revelation 7:1). Job already knew the winds are weighed by the Creator's hand — *To make the weight for the winds; and he weigheth the waters by measure.* (Job 28:25) — and Enoch names the quarters himself in the book of the luminaries: *And the first quarter is called the east, because it is the first: and the second, the south, because the El Elyon (Most High) will descend there, yea, there in quite a special sense will He who is blessed for ever descend. And the west quarter is named the diminished, because there all the luminaries of the heaven wane and go down.* (1 Enoch 77:1-2). The four winds are servants under orders, not powers loose in the world.
3002.note: old 36:1 and 36:3 are not in Charles; the live 36:1-3 carries the portals; 77:1 stood, 77:2 added to complete the quarters; canon kept

3003.title: The winds that bear the earth — the pillars of heaven
3003.summary_md: On the earlier road Enoch had been shown what the gates of the four winds serve: *I saw the treasuries of all the winds: I saw how He had furnished with them the whole creation and the firm foundations of the earth. And I saw the corner-stone of the earth: I saw the four winds which bear [the earth and] the firmament of the heaven. And I saw how the winds stretch out the vaults of heaven, and have their station between heaven and earth: these are the pillars of the heaven.* (1 Enoch 18:1-3). Scripture speaks the same way of the world resting on the Creator's pillars: *He raiseth up the poor out of the dust, and lifteth up the beggar from the dunghill, to set them among princes, and to make them inherit the throne of glory: for the pillars of the earth are the LORD'S, and he hath set the world upon them.* (1 Samuel 2:8). The stretching-out of the heavens is the Creator's own act — *He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heavens by his discretion.* (Jeremiah 10:12) — and when Yahuah answers Job He puts the same foundation in front of him: *Where wast thou when I laid the foundations of the earth? declare, if thou hast understanding.* (Job 38:4). Enoch is not describing brute pillars. He is describing the ordered service of winds holding up what Yahuah founded, and at the end of the journey he blesses the One who founded it: *And as often as I saw I blessed always Yahuah (Lord) of Glory, and I continued to bless Yahuah (Lord) of Glory who has wrought great and glorious wonders, to show the greatness of His work to the angels and to spirits and to men, that they might praise His work and all His creation: that they might see the work of His might and praise the great work of His hands and bless Him for ever.* (1 Enoch 36:4).
3003.note: old 36:4-5 were 18:2-3 under the wrong numbers; re-cited with 18:1 and 36:4 beside them; canon kept

3004.title: All creation ordered by His wisdom — Enoch blesses Yahuah of glory
3004.summary_md: The Book of the Watchers closes with Enoch blessing the Maker of everything he has just been shown: *And as often as I saw I blessed always Yahuah (Lord) of Glory, and I continued to bless Yahuah (Lord) of Glory who has wrought great and glorious wonders, to show the greatness of His work to the angels and to spirits and to men, that they might praise His work and all His creation: that they might see the work of His might and praise the great work of His hands and bless Him for ever.* (1 Enoch 36:4). The canon confesses the same thing in the same words. The world is made by wisdom — *He hath made the earth by his power, he hath established the world by his wisdom, and hath stretched out the heavens by his discretion.* (Jeremiah 10:12) — and its praise goes up from the whole circuit Enoch has just walked: *From the rising of the sun unto the going down of the same the LORD'S name is to be praised.* (Psalm 113:3). Jubilees confesses the same six-day ordering, that even *the angels of the spirit of the winds... and of snow and of hail and of hoar frost* (Jubilees 2:2) were created and set to serve. Enoch says the wonders were shown to angels and spirits and men so that they might praise, and that is the whole purpose of the journey. He ends the way every righteous one ends, blessing the Creator whose wisdom holds the world.
3004.note: old 36:9 is not in Charles; the live 36:4 is the doxology; Proverbs 3:19, Psalm 104:24, 19:1-2, 148:3 dropped (not in the verse index), Jeremiah 10:12 added from it

3169.title: The Holy Great One comes forth from His dwelling to tread the earth at Sinai
3169.summary_md: Enoch's second vision is a vision of wisdom, and he says who it is for: *And this is the beginning of the words of wisdom which I lifted up my voice to speak and say to those which dwell on earth: Hear, ye men of old time, and see, ye that come after, the words of the Holy One which I will speak before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 37:2). Its substance is the same coming he had announced at the very opening of the book: *Concerning the elect I said, and took up my parable concerning them: The Holy Great One will come forth from His dwelling, And the eternal Elohim (God) will tread upon the earth, (even) on Mount Sinai, [And appear from His camp] And appear in the strength of His might from the heaven of heavens.* (1 Enoch 1:3-4). This is the Sinai-coming of the Torah and the prophets, word for word. Moses' blessing opens with it: *Yahuah (LORD) came from Sinai, and rose up from Seir unto them; he shined forth from mount Paran, and he came with ten thousands of saints: from his right hand went a fiery law for them* (Deuteronomy 33:2). Micah sees the same coming forth and treading: *For, behold, Yahuah (LORD) cometh forth out of his place, and will come down, and tread upon the high places of the earth* (Micah 1:3). And Jude lifts the judgement-coming straight off this book: *And Enoch also, the seventh from Adam, prophesied of these, saying, Behold, Yahuah (Lord) cometh with ten thousands of his saints* (Jude 1:14). The One who comes forth here is the Holy Great One in His own might from the heaven of heavens; the Elect One who sits on the throne of glory is not named until the parables reach chapters 46 and 48, and the book keeps that order on purpose. Enoch's Sinai is Moses' Sinai and Micah's, and the men of old time and those who come after are told to hear it together.
3169.note: old 37:5-6 was 1:3-4 under the wrong numbers; re-cited; "the framework keeps" removed; 37:2 quoted to tie the parable to the advent; canon kept

3170.title: The mountains melt like wax; the earth is rent; judgement upon all
3170.summary_md: Before His presence the whole created order gives way, and judgement falls: *And all shall be smitten with fear, And the Watchers shall quake, And great fear and trembling shall seize them unto the ends of the earth. And the high mountains shall be shaken, And the high hills shall be made low, And shall melt like wax before the flame. And the earth shall be wholly rent in sunder, And all that is upon the earth shall perish, And there shall be a judgement upon all (men).* (1 Enoch 1:5-7). Micah carries the melting mountains straight on from the Sinai-advent: *And the mountains shall be molten under him, and the valleys shall be cleft, as wax before the fire, and as the waters that are poured down a steep place* (Micah 1:4). Nahum names the same quaking and burning at His presence: *The mountains quake at him, and the hills melt, and the earth is burned at his presence, yea, the world, and all that dwell therein* (Nahum 1:5), and Isaiah cries out for the very rending Enoch foresees: *Oh that thou wouldest rend the heavens, that thou wouldest come down, that the mountains might flow down at thy presence* (Isaiah 64:1). That the Watchers themselves quake ties this judgement to the war of the seed that this book carries forward from Genesis 6; the same advent that levels the mountains terrifies the ones who left their station. And Enoch says who comes and what for: *And behold! He cometh with ten thousands of His holy ones To execute judgement upon all, And to destroy all the ungodly: And to convict all flesh Of all the works of their ungodliness which they have ungodly committed, And of all the hard things which ungodly sinners have spoken against Him.* (1 Enoch 1:9). The judgement is upon all who broke the order they were given. The law that was broken stands, and the One who gave it is the One coming down.
3170.note: old 37:7-9 was 1:5-7 under the wrong numbers, 1:9 reworded ("set-apart ones"); re-quoted from the live verses; Psalm 97:5 dropped (not in the index); canon kept

3171.title: Peace with the righteous; the elect protected; light appears unto them
3171.summary_md: The same advent that rends the earth turns to mercy for the chosen: *But with the righteous He will make peace. And will protect the elect, And mercy shall be upon them. And they shall all belong to Elohim (God), And they shall be prospered, And they shall all be blessed. And He will help them all, And light shall appear unto them, And He will make peace with them.* (1 Enoch 1:8). The light that appears to the elect is Isaiah's glory rising on the chosen people: *Arise, shine; for thy light is come, and the glory of Yahuah (LORD) is risen upon thee* (Isaiah 60:1). Their belonging to Elohim (God) comes before anything they do about it; they were chosen before they were called: *According as he hath chosen us in him before the foundation of the world, that we should be holy and without blame before him in love* (Ephesians 1:4), and no charge can stand against them — *Who shall lay any thing to the charge of Elohim's (God's) elect? It is Elohim (God) that justifieth* (Romans 8:33). Within Enoch's own parables the same protected lot is named and saved: *And the wisdom of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath revealed him to the holy and righteous; For he hath preserved the lot of the righteous, Because they have hated and despised this world of unrighteousness, And have hated all its works and ways in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: For in his name they are saved, And according to his good pleasure hath it been in regard to their life.* (1 Enoch 48:7). These elect are a people kept and gathered, the righteous of both houses brought home, and the peace He makes with them is the other face of the judgement He brings on everyone else.
3171.note: old 37:10 was 1:8 under the wrong number; re-cited; "the election the framework insists" removed; 48:7 stood and is quoted in full; canon kept

3172.title: The light of the righteous shall shine
3172.summary_md: The first parable opens on the day the two companies are parted: *The First Parable. When the congregation of the righteous shall appear, And sinners shall be judged for their sins, And shall be driven from the face of the earth: And when the Righteous One shall appear before the eyes of the righteous, Whose elect works hang upon Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And light shall appear to the righteous and the elect who dwell on the earth, Where then will be the dwelling of the sinners, And where the resting-place of those who have denied Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits? It had been good for them if they had not been born.* (1 Enoch 38:1-2). Then the light is given, and the mighty cannot look at it: *From that time those that possess the earth shall no longer be powerful and exalted: And they shall not be able to behold the face of the holy, For Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits has caused His light to appear On the face of the holy, righteous, and elect.* (1 Enoch 38:4). Daniel saw the same dawn: *And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever* (Daniel 12:3). Yahusha (Jesus) said it plainly at the end of the wheat and the tares, the very seed-war Enoch's Watchers began: *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear* (Matthew 13:43). The Wisdom of Solomon carries the same hope for the persecuted elect: *And in the time of their visitation they shall shine, and run to and fro like sparks among the stubble* (Wisdom of Solomon 3:7). Notice where the light comes from in Enoch. Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits causes it to appear on their faces. The righteous here are a people kept in covenant and lit from outside themselves, and the shining is given, never earned.
3172.note: old 38:1 and 38:8 were not the Charles words; the live 38:1-2 and 38:4 carry the parable and the light; canon kept

3173.title: The Elect One sits on the throne of glory to judge
3173.summary_md: Enoch names the One who judges: *And he shall judge the secret things, And none shall be able to utter a lying word before him; For he is the Elect One before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits according to His good pleasure.* (1 Enoch 49:4). In the second parable the throne is set under Him in so many words: *On that day Mine Elect One shall sit on the throne of glory And shall try their works, And their places of rest shall be innumerable. And their souls shall grow strong within them when they see Mine elect ones, And those who have called upon My glorious name:* (1 Enoch 45:3). This is a title, not a comparison. The Elect One is chosen and appointed by Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits and seated to judge, and Yahusha (Jesus) took up exactly this throne-language as His own: *When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory* (Matthew 25:31); and to the twelve, *in the regeneration when the Son of Adam shall sit in the throne of his glory, ye also shall sit upon twelve thrones, judging the twelve tribes of Yashar'el (Israel)* (Matthew 19:28), which is the gathered tribes being judged, not a church standing in for them. The Spirit that fits the Elect One to judge truly is the Spirit Isaiah foresaw on the Branch: *And the spirit of Yahuah (LORD) shall rest upon him, the spirit of wisdom and understanding, the spirit of counsel and might, the spirit of knowledge and of the fear of Yahuah (LORD)* (Isaiah 11:2), so that *with righteousness shall he judge the poor, and reprove with equity for the meek of the earth* (Isaiah 11:4). Enoch says the same of him in the verse before the judging: *And in him dwells the spirit of wisdom, And the spirit which gives insight, And the spirit of understanding and of might, And the spirit of those who have fallen asleep in righteousness.* (1 Enoch 49:3).
3173.note: old 38:10 is a paraphrase of 49:4 from the corrupt text; rebuilt on 49:4 and 49:3 with 45:3 (which stood); canon kept

3174.title: The Righteous One appears; the deeds of sinners revealed
3174.summary_md: Before the throne is even set, Enoch names the One who appears: *And when the Righteous One shall appear before the eyes of the righteous, Whose elect works hang upon Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And light shall appear to the righteous and the elect who dwell on the earth, Where then will be the dwelling of the sinners, And where the resting-place of those who have denied Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits? It had been good for them if they had not been born.* (1 Enoch 38:2), and *When the secrets of the righteous shall be revealed and the sinners judged, And the godless driven from the presence of the righteous and elect,* (1 Enoch 38:3). This is the Messiah, the Righteous One in whom righteousness dwells. Isaiah names Him the Father's righteous servant: *He shall see of the travail of his soul, and shall be satisfied: by his knowledge shall my righteous servant justify many; for he shall bear their iniquities* (Isaiah 53:11). The congregation of the righteous that appears with Him is Isaiah's own gate-scene: *Open ye the gates, that the righteous nation which keepeth the truth may enter in* (Isaiah 26:2), a nation that keeps the truth, which is the covenant kept and not a curse escaped. Enoch's parables answer who this Righteous One is: *And he answered and said unto me: This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness, With whom dwelleth righteousness, And who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden, Because Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits hath chosen him, And whose lot hath the pre-eminence before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits in uprightness for ever.* (1 Enoch 46:3). He is chosen and named by the Head of Days before any mouth confesses Him. The choosing comes first, and the confession follows it.
3174.note: old 38:3 was not the Charles words; the live 38:2-3 carry the Righteous One and the secrets revealed; 46:3 stood; canon kept

3175.title: The kings and mighty cast down from their thrones
3175.summary_md: Enoch turns to the powers of the earth: *From that time those that possess the earth shall no longer be powerful and exalted: And they shall not be able to behold the face of the holy, For Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits has caused His light to appear On the face of the holy, righteous, and elect. Then shall the kings and the mighty perish And be given into the hands of the righteous and holy. And thenceforward none shall seek for themselves mercy from Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits For their life is at an end.* (1 Enoch 38:4-6). Revelation shows the same panic of the mighty at the day of wrath: *And the kings of the earth, and the great men, and the rich men, and the chief captains, and the mighty men, and every bondman, and every free man, hid themselves in the dens and in the rocks of the mountains* (Revelation 6:15), crying *Fall on us, and hide us from the face of him that sitteth on the throne, and from the wrath of the Lamb: For the great day of his wrath is come; and who shall be able to stand?* (Revelation 6:17). The furnace is Yahusha's (Jesus') own word for the end of the tares: *And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth* (Matthew 13:42). And Enoch's parables name who does the overthrowing: *And this Son of Adam whom thou hast seen Shall raise up the kings and the mighty from their seats, [And the strong from their thrones] And shall loosen the reins of the strong, And break the teeth of the sinners.* (1 Enoch 46:4). The judgement here is on those who possess the earth and will not acknowledge where their kingdom came from. It is the systems of oppression that are broken, and the people under them are the ones being set free.
3175.note: old 38:6 (furnace of fire) is not in Charles 38; the live 38:4-6 carry the fall of the kings; 62:9 was really 46:4 and is quoted there; canon kept

3176.title: Those who led the world astray bound with chains
3176.summary_md: The first parable asks where the sinners will find a resting-place once the Righteous One appears: *And when the Righteous One shall appear before the eyes of the righteous, Whose elect works hang upon Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And light shall appear to the righteous and the elect who dwell on the earth, Where then will be the dwelling of the sinners, And where the resting-place of those who have denied Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits? It had been good for them if they had not been born.* (1 Enoch 38:2). The third parable answers it: *And he sat on the throne of his glory, And the sum of judgement was given unto the Son of Adam, And he caused the sinners to pass away and be destroyed from off the face of the earth, And those who have led the world astray. With chains shall they be bound, And in their assemblage-place of destruction shall they be imprisoned, And all their works vanish from the face of the earth.* (1 Enoch 69:27-28). The deeds of sinners are revealed before the throne, and that is the scene John saw at the books opened: *And I saw a great white throne, and him that sat on it, from whose face the earth and the heaven fled away* (Revelation 20:11), and *I saw the dead, small and great, stand before Elohim (God); and the books were opened... and the dead were judged out of those things which were written in the books, according to their works* (Revelation 20:12). The waking to that twofold verdict is Daniel's: *And many of them that sleep in the dust of the earth shall awake, some to everlasting life, and some to shame and everlasting contempt* (Daniel 12:2). The chains are the Watchers' own chains carried forward to the ones who learned from them: *And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day* (Jude 1:6). The Creator's order is restored against the rebellion that led the world astray, and the Son of Adam is the one seated to do it.
3176.note: old 38:2 and 38:12 ran 69:27-28 words under chapter 38 numbers; rebuilt on the live 38:2 and 69:27-28; Jude 1:6 added from the verse index; canon kept

3177.title: The dwelling-places of the righteous and the elect
3177.summary_md: Enoch's spirit is carried off and set down where the holy live: *And in those days a whirlwind carried me off from the earth, And set me down at the end of the heavens. And there I saw another vision, the dwelling-places of the holy, And the resting-places of the righteous.* (1 Enoch 39:3-4), and *Here mine eyes saw their dwellings with His righteous angels, And their resting-places with the holy. And they petitioned and interceded and prayed for the children of men, And righteousness flowed before them as water, And mercy like dew upon the earth: Thus it is amongst them for ever and ever.* (1 Enoch 39:5). He longs for the place: *There I wished to dwell, And my spirit longed for that dwelling-place: And there heretofore hath been my portion, For so has it been established concerning me before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 39:8). This is the hope Yahusha (Jesus) names to His own — *In my Father's house are many mansions: if it were not so, I would have told you. I go to prepare a place for you.* (John 14:2) — and the scene John is shown at the throne: *Therefore are they before the throne of Elohim (God), and serve him day and night in his temple: and he that sitteth on the throne shall dwell among them.* (Revelation 7:15). The promise is not escape but dwelling-with. Enoch says the righteous and elect stand without number before the Elect One for ever, and John hears the same thing proclaimed over the renewed earth: *Behold, the tabernacle of Elohim (God) is with men, and he will dwell with them, and they shall be his people* (Revelation 21:3). Enoch's portion in that place was established before he ever saw it, and that is how it is for all the elect: the dwelling is prepared for them before they arrive.
3177.note: old 39:3 and 39:6 were not the Charles words; the live 39:3-5 and 39:8 carry the dwellings; canon kept

3178.title: The Elect One seen in the dwelling of the holy
3178.summary_md: Among the dwelling-places of the holy Enoch sees the One they gather around: *And in that place mine eyes saw the Elect One of righteousness and of faith, And righteousness shall prevail in his days, And the righteous and elect shall be without number before Him for ever and ever. And I saw his dwelling-place under the wings of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits. And all the righteous and elect before Him shall be strong as fiery lights, And their mouth shall be full of blessing, And their lips extol the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And righteousness before Him shall never fail, [And uprightness shall never fail before Him.]* (1 Enoch 39:6-7). He is the Elect One of righteousness and of faith, and his dwelling is under the wings of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, ordered under the Father and set before the righteous at the same time. Isaiah names this same chosen One: *Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him: he shall bring forth judgment to the Gentiles.* (Isaiah 42:1). When Yahusha (Jesus) takes up the title in the flesh, He sets the throne of glory at the centre of the judgement: *When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory:* (Matthew 25:31). Enoch names the Elect One where Daniel only sees *one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days* (Daniel 7:13). Daniel is watching a figure who looks like a mortal man because He took on flesh; Enoch is standing in front of the same One before He did, and the righteous around Him are already strong as fiery lights. He is the chosen One, named before any tongue could call on Him.
3178.note: old 39:5 (voice of the Elect One from the throne) is not in Charles 39; the live 39:6-7 carry the Elect One in the dwelling of the holy; title changed to fit; canon kept

3179.title: Righteousness flowing before them like water
3179.summary_md: Of the resting-places of the holy Enoch says: *Here mine eyes saw their dwellings with His righteous angels, And their resting-places with the holy. And they petitioned and interceded and prayed for the children of men, And righteousness flowed before them as water, And mercy like dew upon the earth: Thus it is amongst them for ever and ever.* (1 Enoch 39:5). The prophet pleads for exactly this outpouring against a crooked generation: *But let judgment run down as waters, and righteousness as a mighty stream.* (Amos 5:24). And the image finds its source at the throne John is shown, where the river of life comes out from the Father and the Lamb: *And he shewed me a pure river of water of life, clear as crystal, proceeding out of the throne of Elohim (God) and of the Lamb.* (Revelation 22:1). Within Enoch's own parables the source is named: *And in that place I saw the fountain of righteousness Which was inexhaustible: And around it were many fountains of wisdom: And all the thirsty drank of them, And were filled with wisdom, And their dwellings were with the righteous and holy and elect.* (1 Enoch 48:1). So the righteousness that flows like water before the holy is not something they make. It draws from a fountain that does not run dry, and they carry it as intercession for the children of men. Righteousness here is a gift flowing out and mercy coming down like dew, and the holy do not keep it to themselves.
3179.note: mechanical draft had a broken lead ("they *Here mine eyes…"); re-cited to 39:5 and the lead sentence mended; 48:1 quoted in full

3180.title: The righteous and elect shall be strong as fiery lights
3180.summary_md: When Enoch is carried to the resting-places of the righteous he sees them already shining in the presence of the Elect One: *And I saw his dwelling-place under the wings of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits. And all the righteous and elect before Him shall be strong as fiery lights, And their mouth shall be full of blessing, And their lips extol the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And righteousness before Him shall never fail, [And uprightness shall never fail before Him.]* (1 Enoch 39:7). Daniel was shown the same light on the same company at the resurrection: *And they that be wise shall shine as the brightness of the firmament; and they that turn many to righteousness as the stars for ever and ever.* (Daniel 12:3). And Yahusha (Jesus) puts it at the harvest, after the tares that were sown among the wheat have been gathered out of the field: *Then shall the righteous shine forth as the sun in the kingdom of their Father. Who hath ears to hear, let him hear.* (Matthew 13:43). Enoch does not count these righteous as a few; he says they *shall be without number before Him for ever and ever* (1 Enoch 39:6), and that their shining is the fruit of being kept under the wings of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, not of any merit of their own. The light the wise carry in Daniel and the sun the righteous become in Matthew is the same fiery strength Enoch saw on the elect before the throne, and it belongs to those who stay in the covenant way until the harvest.
3180.note: 39:9 quote was invented; re-formed on 39:7 (righteous and elect as fiery lights), 39:6 callback; dropped the Psalm 114 / 51:4 tail which no longer sits in ch 39.

3181.title: The four presences around the throne and the accuser cast out
3181.summary_md: Enoch's vision of the throne-room ends with the host that never sleeps and the four who stand nearest: *Those who sleep not bless Thee: they stand before Thy glory and bless, praise, and extol, saying: “Holy, holy, holy, is Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits: He filleth the earth with spirits.”* (1 Enoch 39:12), and then *And on the four sides of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits I saw four presences, different from those that sleep not, and I learnt their names: for the angel that went with me made known to me their names, and showed me all the hidden things.* (1 Enoch 40:2). John is shown the same four about the same throne, with the same cry on their lips: *And the four beasts had each of them six wings about him; and they were full of eyes within: and they rest not day and night, saying, Holy, holy, holy, Yahuah Elohim (Lord God) Almighty, which was, and is, and is to come.* (Revelation 4:8). One of the four has a particular office, and Enoch hears it at work: *And I heard the fourth voice fending off the Satans and forbidding them to come before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits to accuse them who dwell on the earth.* (1 Enoch 40:7). That is the office whose victory John proclaims, *the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our Elohim (God) day and night.* (Revelation 12:10), the accuser who in Zechariah's court stood *at his right hand to resist* the high priest (Zechariah 3:1). The third voice prays for those on the earth, and Tobit knows that ministry by name: *I am Raphael, one of the seven holy angels, which present the prayers of the saints, and which go in and out before the glory of the Holy One.* (Tobit 12:15). The angel names all four for Enoch, Michael, Raphael, Gabriel and Phanuel (1 Enoch 40:9). They are created servants who stand around the throne and plead for men; none of them sits on it.
3181.note: 39:11/39:16/39:18 do not exist in Charles; re-anchored the quotes on 39:12, 40:2, 40:7, 40:9.

3182.title: Thousands of thousands before the Yahuah of Spirits
3182.summary_md: Enoch is lifted into the throne-room and tries to count the host: *And after that I saw thousands of thousands and ten thousand times ten thousand, I saw a multitude beyond number and reckoning, who stood before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 40:1). Daniel sees the same court convene for judgement and uses the same numbers: *A fiery stream issued and came forth from before him: thousand thousands ministered unto him, and ten thousand times ten thousand stood before him: the judgment was set, and the books were opened.* (Daniel 7:10). John, carried up in the Spirit, hears the very same count around the throne, *the number of them was ten thousand times ten thousand, and thousands of thousands;* (Revelation 5:11), and watches the whole assembly go down on its face: *And all the angels stood round about the throne, and about the elders and the four beasts, and fell before the throne on their faces, and worshipped Elohim (God),* (Revelation 7:11). Enoch, Daniel and John each stood in the one court and counted the one host, and all three gave up counting at the same place.
3182.note: 40:1 re-quoted from the live verse (the old words were a paraphrase); prose kept.

3183.title: The four presences and the voice of praise
3183.summary_md: Around the throne stand four faces lifting praise: *And on the four sides of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits I saw four presences, different from those that sleep not, and I learnt their names: for the angel that went with me made known to me their names, and showed me all the hidden things.* (1 Enoch 40:2), *And I heard the voices of those four presences as they uttered praises before Yahuah (God) of glory.* (1 Enoch 40:3), *The first voice blesses Yahuah (God) of Spirits for ever and ever.* (1 Enoch 40:4). Isaiah was shown the same attendants at the same throne, and their whole work is praise: *Above it stood the seraphims: each one had six wings; with twain he covered his face, and with twain he covered his feet, and with twain he did fly.* (Isaiah 6:2). Their cry, *And one cried unto another, and said, Holy, holy, holy, is Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts): the whole earth is full of his glory.* (Isaiah 6:3), is the first of Enoch's four voices, blessing the Yahuah of Spirits for ever. John records the matching scene of the four living creatures and the host ringed about the throne in ceaseless worship (Revelation 7:11). The four presences are the seraphim of the temple vision, seen by another prophet from another angle.
3183.note: draft stood; smoothed the closing sentence.

3184.title: The second voice blesses the Elect One
3184.summary_md: The second of the four voices is reserved for One who is blessed beside the Yahuah of Spirits: *And the second voice I heard blessing the Elect One and the elect ones who hang upon Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 40:5). The Elect One is the Formed Son who proceeds from the Head of Days, chosen and named before creation, blessed with the Father and ordered under Him, and this same book names him a few chapters on: *This is the Son of Adam who hath righteousness ... because Yahuah (God) of Spirits hath chosen him* (1 Enoch 46:3), *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (God) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days.* (1 Enoch 48:2). Isaiah had already announced him as the chosen one on whom the Spirit rests: *Behold my servant, whom I uphold; mine elect, in whom my soul delighteth; I have put my spirit upon him* (Isaiah 42:1). When Daniel sees him brought to the throne he keeps the comparison, *behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days* (Daniel 7:13): Daniel sees one like the Son of Adam, because the one he saw would take on flesh while remaining the Formed, and Enoch names that same one the Elect One. John sees him among the lampstands with the same comparison, *one like unto the Son of Adam* (Revelation 1:13). The elect ones who hang upon the Yahuah of Spirits are his people, chosen with him before they ever heard his voice.
3184.note: 40:11 is not in Charles; dropped it. 46:3 and 48:2 stand as quoted in the old text (not in this packet's chapters beyond 46/48 which are supplied).

3185.title: The third voice intercedes; the fourth fends off the satans
3185.summary_md: Two of the four voices do heaven's work for the people of the earth: *And the third voice I heard pray and intercede for those who dwell on the earth and supplicate in the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 40:6), *And I heard the fourth voice fending off the Satans and forbidding them to come before Yahuah (God) of Spirits to accuse them who dwell on the earth.* (1 Enoch 40:7). Zechariah is shown that very accusing satan standing against a man before the angel of Yahuah: *And he shewed me Joshua the high priest standing before the angel of Yahuah (LORD), and Satan standing at his right hand to resist him.* (Zechariah 3:1), and John hears the day the accuser is silenced for good: *for the accuser of our brethren is cast down, which accused them before our Elohim (God) day and night.* (Revelation 12:10). The voice that prays for men is not a stray piece of angel-lore either. Raphael names himself as the one who carries prayers up: *I am Raphael, one of the seven holy angels, which present the prayers of the saints, and which go in and out before the glory of the Holy One.* (Tobit 12:15), and the same prayer rises as incense in John's throne-room: *And another angel came and stood at the altar, having a golden censer ... that he should offer it with the prayers of all saints upon the golden altar which was before the throne.* (Revelation 8:3). Above every created intercessor stands the Son of Adam himself, who *maketh intercession for us* (Romans 8:34); the angels' prayer points toward him.
3185.note: 40:6 re-quoted; 'interceding' in prose now reads 'the voice that prays for men'.

3186.title: Michael, Raphael, Gabriel, Phanuel — the four named
3186.summary_md: Enoch's guide names the four presences for him: *And he said to me: ‘This first is Michael, the merciful and long- suffering: and the second, who is set over all the diseases and all the wounds of the children of men, is Raphael: and the third, who is set over all the powers, is Gabriel: and the fourth, who is set over the repentance unto hope of those who inherit eternal life, is named Phanuel.’* (1 Enoch 40:9). Michael is the prince Daniel knows, the one who stands for the people: *And at that time shall Michael stand up, the great prince which standeth for the children of thy people* (Daniel 12:1), and Jude calls him the archangel who would not rail against the accuser on his own authority, *Yet Michael the archangel, when contending with the devil he disputed about the body of Moses ... but said, Yahuah (Lord) rebuke thee.* (Jude 1:9), which is the merciful and long-suffering Michael of Enoch's vision. Raphael, set over all the diseases and wounds of the children of men, is the healer Tobit met, who also carries the prayers of the saints: *I am Raphael, one of the seven holy angels, which present the prayers of the saints* (Tobit 12:15). And this ordering of named ministers over the works of creation is the order Jubilees records from the first day: *the angels of the spirit of the winds, and the angels of the spirit of the clouds, and of darkness, and of snow and of hail* (Jubilees 2:2). The four are the canon's own named ministers, not a mythology Enoch brought in from outside.
3186.note: 'sickness' in prose aligned to the live verse's 'diseases and wounds'.

3187.title: The hidden things shown to Enoch and kept for the elect
3187.summary_md: The angel who walks with Enoch through the throne-room does not keep him at the door; he opens the storehouses: *And on the four sides of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits I saw four presences, different from those that sleep not, and I learnt their names: for the angel that went with me made known to me their names, and showed me all the hidden things.* (1 Enoch 40:2), and when Enoch asks who the four are, it is *the angel of peace who went with me, who showed me everything that is hidden* (1 Enoch 40:8) who answers. The Torah had already said where the secret things live and to whom the revealed things are given: *The secret things belong unto Yahuah Eloheinu (the LORD our God): but those things which are revealed belong unto us and to our children for ever, that we may do all the words of this law.* (Deuteronomy 29:29). The storehouses Enoch is walked past are the ones Yahuah asks Job about, *Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail* (Job 38:22), and it is the Son of Adam, the Elect One, *who revealeth all the treasures of that which is hidden* (1 Enoch 46:3). Yahusha (Jesus) promises his own the same unsealing: *Fear them not therefore: for there is nothing covered, that shall not be revealed; and hid, that shall not be known.* (Matthew 10:26). The secrets are not hoarded. They are kept for the righteous and elect, the people chosen together with the Elect One, and shown to them in their season.
3187.note: 40:13/40:21/40:24 do not exist in Charles; thread re-formed on 40:2 and 40:8 (the angel shows Enoch the hidden things), kept Job 38:22, 46:3, Matt 10:26; added Deut 29:29 from the index; dropped Daniel 2:22 and 1 Cor 2:10 (not in the index).

3188.title: The actions of men weighed in the balance
3188.summary_md: Enoch is shown the most sober secret of heaven: *And after that I saw all the secrets of the heavens, and how the kingdom is divided, and how the actions of men are weighed in the balance.* (1 Enoch 41:1). The same scale hangs over Belshazzar's feast: *TEKEL; Thou art weighed in the balances, and art found wanting.* (Daniel 5:27), the writing on the wall that reckons a king's deeds against the standard he had spurned. The balance belongs to the Creator and not to men who would rig it: *A just weight and balance are the LORD'S: all the weights of the bag are his work.* (Proverbs 16:11). And the weighing is no figure of speech for the conscience, because later in these same Parables the angel shows Enoch the measuring of creation itself: *And the chambers of the winds, and how the winds are divided, and how they are weighed, and (how) the portals of the winds are reckoned, each according to the power of the wind, and the power of the lights of the moon, and according to the power that is fitting: and the divisions of the stars according to their names, and how all the divisions are divided.* (1 Enoch 60:12). A Creator who weighs the winds will weigh the deeds of men. The judgement falls on deeds because the covenant was given to be kept; the balance vindicates the righteous who walked in the way and exposes the sinners who deny the name of Yahuah of Spirits.
3188.note: 60:11 was re-quoted as 60:12 by the mechanical pass; mended the prose around 'weighing' and fixed 'sinner who deny'.

3190.title: The chambers of sun and moon: the kept orbit and the divided light
3190.summary_md: Enoch sees the luminaries hold their appointed course and keep faith with one another: *And I saw the chambers of the sun and moon, whence they proceed and whither they come again, and their glorious return, and how one is superior to the other, and their stately orbit, and how they do not leave their orbit, and they add nothing to their orbit and they take nothing from it, and they keep faith with each other, in accordance with the oath by which they are bound together.* (1 Enoch 41:5). The sun goes out first, *And first the sun goes forth and traverses his path according to the commandment of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, and mighty is His name for ever and ever.* (1 Enoch 41:6), and the moon follows her own hidden and visible path, *the one holding a position opposite to the other before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits* (1 Enoch 41:7). Then Enoch says what the lights are for: *For the sun changes oft for a blessing or a curse, And the course of the path of the moon is light to the righteous And darkness to the sinners in the name of Yahuah (Lord), Who made a separation between the light and the darkness, And divided the spirits of men, And strengthened the spirits of the righteous, In the name of His righteousness.* (1 Enoch 41:8). This is Genesis read back to us: *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:* (Genesis 1:14), lights set for the appointed times, the moon *appointed... for seasons* (Psalm 104:19). Their faithful course is the guarantee Yahuah hangs the covenant on: *Thus saith Yahuah (LORD), which giveth the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night... Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name:* (Jeremiah 31:35), and the next verse says that only if those ordinances fail will the seed of Yashar'el (Israel) cease. Jubilees ties the same fourth-day lights straight to the feast calendar: *And on the fourth day He created the sun and the moon and the stars... to rule over the day and the night, and divide the light from the darkness.* (Jubilees 2:8). The luminaries keep their oath, and the feasts are appointed by the lights; that order was Torah's before it was anyone else's.
3190.note: 41:6 'monthly revolution' was invented; 41:6-8 quoted from the live verses in full.

3191.title: Nothing hinders His order: He appoints the judge and judges all
3191.summary_md: Enoch closes the chapter on the lights with the reason their course never fails: *For no angel hinders and no power is able to hinder; for He appoints a judge for them all and He judges them all before Him.* (1 Enoch 41:9). The sun and moon keep faith because no created power can get between them and the commandment they run on, and the same hand that set the judge over the lights sits in judgement over men, which Enoch had already seen at the head of the chapter, *how the actions of men are weighed in the balance* (1 Enoch 41:1).
