4037.summary_md: Noah sees the world itself giving way under the weight of what has been done on it: *And in those days Noah saw the earth that it had sunk down and its destruction was nigh.* (1 Enoch 65:1), *And I said unto him: ‘Tell me what it is that is falling out on the earth that the earth is in such evil plight and shaken, lest perchance I shall perish with it?’* (1 Enoch 65:3). This is Genesis told from inside the house of the man who built the ark. Moses names the same ruin: *The earth also was corrupt before Elohim (God), and the earth was filled with violence.* (Genesis 6:11), *And Elohim (God) looked upon the earth, and, behold, it was corrupt; for all flesh had corrupted his way upon the earth.* (Genesis 6:12), so that *Yahuah (LORD) said, I will destroy man whom I have created from the face of the earth* (Genesis 6:7). Jubilees records the same flood of lawlessness that wearied the ground: *And lawlessness increased on the earth and all flesh corrupted its way... and they began to devour each other* (Jubilees 5:2). And Enoch gives Noah the reason straight from the throne: *And a command has gone forth from the presence of Yahuah (Lord) concerning those who dwell on the earth that their ruin is accomplished because they have learnt all the secrets of the angels, and all the violence of the Satans, and all their powers—the most secret ones—and all the power of those who practise sorcery, and the power of witchcraft, and the power of those who make molten images for the whole earth:* (1 Enoch 65:6). The earth sinks because the people on it took up what the angels taught. The judgement falls on a creation defiled, and the order the Creator set for it is the thing being vindicated, not the thing being set aside.
4037.note: 65:3 was quoted in invented words; re-quoted live 65:1, 65:3 and added live 65:6 (the reason); Genesis and Jubilees kept.

4038.title: Noah cries to Enoch; Enoch brings back the word of judgement
4038.summary_md: Noah runs to the ends of the earth and cries out to the grandfather who was taken: *And he arose from thence and went to the ends of the earth, and cried aloud to his grandfather Enoch: and Noah said three times with an embittered voice: ‘Hear me, hear me, hear me.’* (1 Enoch 65:2). Enoch comes to him, asks why he weeps, and gives him the answer he has carried down from the presence of Yahuah: *And a command has gone forth from the presence of Yahuah (Lord) concerning those who dwell on the earth that their ruin is accomplished because they have learnt all the secrets of the angels, and all the violence of the Satans, and all their powers—the most secret ones—and all the power of those who practise sorcery, and the power of witchcraft, and the power of those who make molten images for the whole earth:* (1 Enoch 65:6), *And after that my grandfather Enoch took hold of me by my hand and raised me up, and said unto me: ‘Go, for I have asked Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits as touching this commotion on the earth.* (1 Enoch 65:9), *And He said unto me: “Because of their unrighteousness their judgement has been determined upon and shall not be withheld by Me for ever. Because of the sorceries which they have searched out and learnt, the earth and those who dwell upon it shall be destroyed.”* (1 Enoch 65:10). The man who walked with Elohim and was taken is still the one carrying the warning, and the warning is that the judgement has been decided and will not be held back. Peter sets the same word against the same scoffers: *whose judgment now of a long time lingereth not, and their damnation slumbereth not.* (2 Peter 2:3). And Yahusha (Jesus) hangs the last days on these very days of Noah, when men ate and drank and knew nothing until the flood came. The judgement is announced, it is patient, and it does not slumber.
4038.note: 65:6 'did not cease to speak' was invented; re-formed on live 65:2, 65:6, 65:9-10 (Enoch's answer to Noah); Peter kept; title adjusted.

4039.title: The angels who descended taught mankind sin
4039.summary_md: Enoch names the root of the ruin for Noah, and it is the teaching of the angels who came down: *And a command has gone forth from the presence of Yahuah (Lord) concerning those who dwell on the earth that their ruin is accomplished because they have learnt all the secrets of the angels, and all the violence of the Satans, and all their powers—the most secret ones—and all the power of those who practise sorcery, and the power of witchcraft, and the power of those who make molten images for the whole earth:* (1 Enoch 65:6), *And He said unto me: “Because of their unrighteousness their judgement has been determined upon and shall not be withheld by Me for ever. Because of the sorceries which they have searched out and learnt, the earth and those who dwell upon it shall be destroyed.”* (1 Enoch 65:10). That is Enoch's own earlier testimony brought forward to Noah's door: *And Azâzêl taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates, and made known to them the metals of the earth and the art of working them, and bracelets, and ornaments, and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, and all kinds of costly stones, and all colouring tinctures.* (1 Enoch 8:1), *And there arose much godlessness, and they committed fornication, and they were led astray, and became corrupt in all their ways.* (1 Enoch 8:2). Jubilees tells the same descent, when *the angels of Elohim (God) saw them... and they took themselves wives of all whom they chose, and they bare to them sons and they were giants.* (Jubilees 5:1). Jude and Peter carry it into the apostolic writings: *And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.* (Jude 1:6), *For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment* (2 Peter 2:4). The sin of the Watchers was teaching men what was hidden, and what they sowed runs straight into the flood Noah is about to live through.
4039.note: 65:9-10 were invented; re-formed on live 65:6, 65:10 and 8:1-2; Jubilees, Jude, Peter kept.

4040.title: The earth cleansed; all made righteous to worship
4040.summary_md: Past the judgement, Enoch's word to Noah ends on the seed that comes through it: *And He has destined thy name to be among the holy, And will preserve thee amongst those who dwell on the earth, And has destined thy righteous seed both for kingship and for great honours, And from thy seed shall proceed a fountain of the righteous and holy without number for ever.’* (1 Enoch 65:12). The world that seed is kept for is the one Enoch had already been shown when the command went out to the angels: *And cleanse thou the earth from all oppression, and from all unrighteousness, and from all sin, and from all godlessness: and all the uncleanness that is wrought upon the earth destroy from off the earth.* (1 Enoch 10:20), *And all the children of men shall become righteous, and all nations shall offer adoration and shall praise Me, and all shall worship Me.* (1 Enoch 10:21), *And the earth shall be cleansed from all defilement, and from all sin, and from all punishment, and from all torment, and I will never again send (them) upon it from generation to generation and for ever.* (1 Enoch 10:22). Jubilees seals the same renewal after the flood: *And He made for all His works a new and righteous nature, so that they should not sin in their whole nature for ever, but should be all righteous each in his kind alway.* (Jubilees 5:11), and Yahuah vows *I will not again curse the ground any more for man's sake* (Genesis 8:21). The cleansing is the Creator restoring his own order on the earth, and the fountain of the righteous that comes out of Noah is the people he restores it for.
4040.note: 65:12-13 'cleansed' quotes were the corrupt text; the live 65:12 is Noah's seed, so the thread now runs 65:12 → 10:20-22; Jubilees and Genesis kept.

4041.title: Noah preserved; a fountain of the righteous from his seed
4041.summary_md: Enoch's last word to Noah is that he has been set apart before the waters ever rise: *And these—they have no place of repentance for ever, because they have shown them what was hidden, and they are the damned: but as for thee, my son, Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits knows that thou art pure, and guiltless of this reproach concerning the secrets.* (1 Enoch 65:11), *And He has destined thy name to be among the holy, And will preserve thee amongst those who dwell on the earth, And has destined thy righteous seed both for kingship and for great honours, And from thy seed shall proceed a fountain of the righteous and holy without number for ever.’* (1 Enoch 65:12). Noah is not preserved because he picked himself out. Moses says grace came first: *But Noah found grace in the eyes of Yahuah (LORD).* (Genesis 6:8), and then describes the walk that grace produced: *Noah was a just man and perfect in his generations, and Noah walked with Elohim (God).* (Genesis 6:9). Jubilees keeps the same order: *no man’s person was accepted save that of Noah alone; for his person was accepted in behalf of his sons, whom Elohim (God) saved from the waters of the flood on his account; for his heart was righteous in all his ways* (Jubilees 5:19). His name was destined among the holy and his seed was destined for kingship before the flood came, and the righteousness he walked out was the fruit of that, never the price of it.
4041.note: 65:14 does not exist; re-formed on live 65:11-12; Genesis and Jubilees kept; title adjusted to the live verse.

4042.title: The angels over the waters, held in check until the word
4042.summary_md: Enoch sees the executioners of the deluge standing ready and then held back: *And after that he showed me the angels of punishment who are prepared to come and let loose all the powers of the waters which are beneath in the earth in order to bring judgement and destruction on all who [abide and] dwell on the earth.* (1 Enoch 66:1), *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits gave commandment to the angels who were going forth, that they should not cause the waters to rise but should hold them in check; for those angels were over the powers of the waters.* (1 Enoch 66:2). This is the canon's own flood, told from the side of the ones who hold the deep until they are told to let it go: *In the six hundredth year of Noah’s life, in the second month, the seventeenth day of the month, the same day were all the fountains of the great deep broken up, and the windows of heaven were opened* (Genesis 7:11). The Parables had already named both chambers a few chapters earlier: *And in those days shall punishment come from Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, and He will open all the chambers of waters which are above the heavens, and of the fountains which are beneath the earth* (1 Enoch 54:7). The deep above and the deep below are the very waters Genesis opens. And the picture of angels set over the elements, holding them until the word is given, runs straight to John's vision of a judgement held in check: *And after these things I saw four angels standing on the four corners of the earth, holding the four winds of the earth, that the wind should not blow on the earth, nor on the sea, nor on any tree* (Revelation 7:1). The messengers stand ready, and nothing is loosed until the Creator commands it. It ain't new.
4042.note: 66:4 does not exist; re-quoted live 66:1-2 (the holding in check); Genesis, 54:7, Revelation kept.

4043.title: The waters loosed on the ungodly, and then sworn never again
4043.summary_md: The angels of punishment are shown to Enoch with the waters in their hands, and what the waters are for is said plainly: *And after that he showed me the angels of punishment who are prepared to come and let loose all the powers of the waters which are beneath in the earth in order to bring judgement and destruction on all who [abide and] dwell on the earth.* (1 Enoch 66:1). That is exactly how the canon frames the deluge, a flood on the world of the ungodly with the one righteous man carried through it: *And spared not the old world, but saved Noah the eighth person, a preacher of righteousness, bringing in the flood upon the world of the ungodly* (2 Peter 2:5). The waters went out by command and they were stopped by command: *The fountains also of the deep and the windows of heaven were stopped, and the rain from heaven was restrained* (Genesis 8:2), the same fountains and windows Genesis opened in the six hundredth year of Noah, shut again. And the Parables carry the oath that followed, the Head of Days swearing by his own name that he will not do it twice: *And He sware by His great name: ‘Henceforth I will not do so to all who dwell on the earth, and I will set a sign in the heaven: and this shall be a pledge of good faith between Me and them for ever, so long as heaven is above the earth. And this is in accordance with My command.* (1 Enoch 55:2). The next verse keeps the judgement itself alive even while the flood is sworn off: *When I have desired to take hold of them by the hand of the angels on the day of tribulation and pain because of this, I will cause My chastisement and My wrath to abide upon them, saith Elohim (God), Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits.* (1 Enoch 55:3). The water will not come back, but the day of tribulation will, by the hand of the same angels.
4043.note: 66:5-6 do not exist (the live chapter is three verses); re-formed on live 66:1 and 55:2-3; Peter and Genesis kept; title adjusted.

4044.title: The righteous and elect saved, dwelling in the light
4044.summary_md: Where the ungodly perish, the elect are kept, and Enoch says it on the day the Son of Adam sits down: *And the righteous and elect shall be saved on that day, And they shall never thenceforward see the face of the sinners and unrighteous.* (1 Enoch 62:13), *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits will abide over them, And with that Son of Adam shall they eat And lie down and rise up for ever and ever.* (1 Enoch 62:14). The flood was the first picture of that division, the same Lord who drowns the ungodly carrying his own through: *Yahuah (Lord) knoweth how to deliver the godly out of temptations, and to reserve the unjust unto the day of judgment to be punished* (2 Peter 2:9), and the angels over the waters in this chapter were told to hold them until he said otherwise: *And Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits gave commandment to the angels who were going forth, that they should not cause the waters to rise but should hold them in check; for those angels were over the powers of the waters.* (1 Enoch 66:2). The place the kept ones are kept for is the light the Parables sing of elsewhere: *And the righteous shall be in the light of the sun, And the elect in the light of eternal life: The days of their life shall be unending, And the days of the holy without number.* (1 Enoch 58:3), and it is the city John saw: *And there shall be no night there; and they need no candle, neither light of the sun; for Yahuah Elohim (the Lord God) giveth them light: and they shall reign for ever and ever* (Revelation 22:5). The righteous here are a preserved people. They are saved because the Most High preserves them, and they are kept in his light for ever.
4044.note: 66:8-9 do not exist; re-formed on live 62:13-14, 66:2, 58:3; Peter and Revelation kept.

4045.title: The fallen angels imprisoned in the burning valley
4045.summary_md: After the promise over Noah's seed, the word turns to the angels who led the earth astray, and the sentence is given a place: *And He will imprison those angels, who have shown unrighteousness, in that burning valley which my grandfather Enoch had formerly shown to me in the west among the mountains of gold and silver and iron and soft metal and tin.* (1 Enoch 67:4), *And through its valleys proceed streams of fire, where these angels are punished who had led astray those who dwell upon the earth.* (1 Enoch 67:7). The four archangels are the ones who carry it out: *And Michael, and Gabriel, and Raphael, and Phanuel shall take hold of them on that great day, and cast them on that day into the burning furnace, that Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits may take vengeance on them for their unrighteousness in becoming subject to Satan and leading astray those who dwell on the earth.’* (1 Enoch 54:6), and the earlier word over Semjâzâ and his company set the same end: *In those days they shall be led off to the abyss of fire: and to the torment and the prison in which they shall be confined for ever.* (1 Enoch 10:13). This is the canon's own Genesis 6 rebellion held over for sentence: *And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day* (Jude 1:6), *For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment* (2 Peter 2:4). Yahusha (Jesus) uses Enoch's own furnace when he tells where the tares go: *And shall cast them into a furnace of fire: there shall be wailing and gnashing of teeth* (Matthew 13:42). And Michael says what the whole scene is for: *And I heard Michael answering and saying: ‘This judgement wherewith the angels are judged is a testimony for the kings and the mighty who possess the earth.’* (1 Enoch 67:12). The angels left the place they were given and led the earth astray, and the burning valley is the answer to that. It ain't new.
4045.note: 67:1-2 were invented; re-formed on live 67:4, 67:7, 67:12 with 54:6 and 10:13; Jude, Peter, Matthew kept; title adjusted.

4048.title: The earth cleansed from all corruption
4048.summary_md: The judgement in this chapter burns in a valley under the land, and it is aimed at the ones who led the earth astray: *And when all this took place, from that fiery molten metal and from the convulsion thereof in that place, there was produced a smell of sulphur, and it was connected with those waters, and that valley of the angels who had led astray (mankind) burned beneath that land.* (1 Enoch 67:6), *And through its valleys proceed streams of fire, where these angels are punished who had led astray those who dwell upon the earth.* (1 Enoch 67:7). That fire is not the end of the story; it is how the earth is made clean. The command Enoch heard in the first vision says what the burning is for: *And cleanse thou the earth from all oppression, and from all unrighteousness, and from all sin, and from all godlessness: and all the uncleanness that is wrought upon the earth destroy from off the earth.* (1 Enoch 10:20). The prophets and the apostles look to the same cleansed creation: *For, behold, I create new heavens and a new earth: and the former shall not be remembered, nor come into mind* (Isaiah 65:17), *Nevertheless we, according to his promise, look for new heavens and a new earth, wherein dwelleth righteousness* (2 Peter 3:13), and John sees it done: *And I saw a new heaven and a new earth: for the first heaven and the first earth were passed away; and there was no more sea* (Revelation 21:1). The defilement the Watchers brought in at Genesis 6 is finally undone, and the order the Creator set is what is left standing where the corruption used to be. It ain't new.
4048.note: Mechanical re-quote stood; added the anchor's own 67:6-7 and mended the prose.

4049.title: Two hundred who swore on Hermon — the angels who left their estate
4049.summary_md: Michael and Raphael speak together in this chapter about a judgement so severe the angels under it melt away: *And on that day Michael answered Raphael and said: ‘The power of the spirit transports and makes me to tremble because of the severity of the judgement of the secrets, the judgement of the angels: who can endure the severe judgement which has been executed, and before which they melt away?’* (1 Enoch 68:2), and Michael will not plead for them: *And it came to pass when he stood before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, Michael said thus to Raphael: ‘I will not take their part under the eye of Yahuah (Lord); for Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits has been angry with them because they do as if they were Yahuah (Lord).* (1 Enoch 68:4). The ones under that sentence are the two hundred Enoch named at the start, with the mountain and the oath: *And they were in all two hundred; who descended in the days of Jared on the summit of Mount Hermon, and they called it Mount Hermon, because they had sworn and bound themselves by mutual imprecations upon it.* (1 Enoch 6:6). This is the canon's own Genesis 6, told in fuller detail. Moses records the descent: *That the sons of Elohim (God) saw the daughters of men that they were fair; and they took them wives of all which they chose.* (Genesis 6:2), and the offspring: *There were giants in the earth in those days; and also after that, when the sons of Elohim (God) came in unto the daughters of men, and they bare children to them, the same became mighty men which were of old, men of renown.* (Genesis 6:4). The apostles read it the same way, as a rebellion already under sentence: *And the angels which kept not their first estate, but left their own habitation, he hath reserved in everlasting chains under darkness unto the judgment of the great day.* (Jude 6), *For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;* (2 Peter 2:4). Jubilees carries the same descent: *the angels of Elohim (God) saw them... and they took themselves wives of all whom they chose, and they bare to them sons and they were giants.* (Jubilees 5:1). The Watchers of Enoch are the sons of Elohim of Genesis 6, and the trouble that runs through the whole earth after them began with that oath on Hermon.
4049.note: Mechanical re-quote stood; added the live 68:2 and 68:4 so the chapter thread stands on chapter 68; mended the prose.

4050.title: Azazel taught the arts — and the earth was filled with corruption
4050.summary_md: The judgement Michael trembles at in this chapter was earned by teaching. Enoch records what the Watchers taught and what it bred: *And Azâzêl taught men to make swords, and knives, and shields, and breastplates, and made known to them the metals of the earth and the art of working them, and bracelets, and ornaments, and the use of antimony, and the beautifying of the eyelids, and all kinds of costly stones, and all colouring tinctures.* (1 Enoch 8:1), *Semjâzâ taught enchantments, and root-cuttings, Armârôs the resolving of enchantments, Barâqîjâl (taught) astrology, Kôkabêl the constellations, Êzêqêêl the knowledge of the clouds, Araqiêl the signs of the earth, Shamsiêl the signs of the sun, and Sariêl the course of the moon.* (1 Enoch 8:3). The fruit of it is named plainly: *And there arose much godlessness, and they committed fornication, and they were led astray, and became corrupt in all their ways.* (1 Enoch 8:2), which is the verdict of Genesis in almost the same words: *The earth also was corrupt before Elohim (God), and the earth was filled with violence.* (Genesis 6:11). Michael's reason for refusing to plead for them is that they set themselves up in the Creator's place: *for Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits has been angry with them because they do as if they were Yahuah (Lord).* (1 Enoch 68:4). And the arts they handed down, the divination and enchantment and reading of times and heavens, are the very things the Torah forbids by name: *There shall not be found among you any one that maketh his son or his daughter to pass through the fire, or that useth divination, or an observer of times, or an enchanter, or a witch,* (Deuteronomy 18:10). What the Watchers taught was never knowledge; it was a way of acting as if they were Yahuah, and the Torah draws the line exactly where they crossed it.
4050.note: 68:7-9 do not exist; the quotes live at 8:1-3 and the anchor sits there; added live 68:4 to tie the chapter in; Genesis and Deuteronomy kept.

4051.title: Their cry went up to heaven — the host reserved unto judgment
4051.summary_md: The record of what the Watchers taught closes on the groan of the ruined earth: *And as men perished, they cried, and their cry went up to heaven...* (1 Enoch 8:4). That cry is not left unanswered. The judgement Michael and Raphael speak of in this chapter is the answer to it: *Therefore all that is hidden shall come upon them for ever and ever; for neither angel nor man shall have his portion (in it), but alone they have received their judgement for ever and ever.’* (1 Enoch 68:5). Isaiah saw the same sentence from the other side, the host of heaven shut up in the pit the way Enoch's Watchers are bound: *And it shall come to pass in that day, that Yahuah (LORD) shall punish the host of the high ones that are on high, and the kings of the earth upon the earth.* (Isaiah 24:21), *And they shall be gathered together, as prisoners are gathered in the pit, and shall be shut up in the prison, and after many days shall they be visited.* (Isaiah 24:22). Peter and Jude hold them in the same chains, reserved unto judgment, and Revelation carries the sentence to its end, when the deceiver himself is given over: *And the devil that deceived them was cast into the lake of fire and brimstone, where the beast and the false prophet are, and shall be tormented day and night for ever and ever.* (Revelation 20:10). The cry that went up from the earth in Enoch's day is the cry the whole library answers with the great day of judgement. It ain't new.
4051.note: 68:10 does not exist; the quote lives at 8:4 where the anchor sits; added live 68:5; Isaiah and Revelation kept; fixed the close that said the cry rises in chapter 68.

4055.title: The Name of the Son of Adam revealed; he sits on the throne of glory
4055.summary_md: The third Parable ends with the oath that holds creation together, and then with joy, because a name has been made known: *And there was great joy amongst them, And they blessed and glorified and extolled Because the name of that Son of Adam had been revealed unto them.* (1 Enoch 69:26), *And he sat on the throne of his glory, And the sum of judgement was given unto the Son of Adam, And he caused the sinners to pass away and be destroyed from off the face of the earth, And those who have led the world astray.* (1 Enoch 69:27), *And from henceforth there shall be nothing corruptible; For that Son of Adam has appeared, And has seated himself on the throne of his glory, And all evil shall pass away before his face, And the word of that Son of Adam shall go forth And be strong before Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits. This is the third Parable of Enoch.* (1 Enoch 69:29). Enoch names him. He is the one who proceeds from the Head of Days, chosen and named before anything was made: *And at that hour that Son of Adam was named In the presence of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits, And his name before the Head of Days* (1 Enoch 48:2). Daniel saw the same one, and said *like*, because the one he saw would take on flesh and look like a man while remaining the one who rides the clouds: *I saw in the night visions, and, behold, one like the Son of Adam came with the clouds of heaven, and came to the Ancient of days, and they brought him near before him. And there was given him dominion, and glory, and a kingdom* (Daniel 7:13-14). The Gospel drops the *like*, because by then the named one had come: *When the Son of Adam shall come in his glory, and all the holy angels with him, then shall he sit upon the throne of his glory* (Matthew 25:31). And the name that was hidden and then revealed is the name above every name: *Wherefore Elohim (God) also hath highly exalted him, and given him a name which is above every name: That at the name of Yahusha (Jesus) every knee should bow* (Philippians 2:9-10). He is worshipped with the Father and set under him, and his name was named before the world was.
4055.note: 69:30-33 numbering was the corrupt text; re-quoted live 69:26-27, 29 and 48:2; canon kept; smoothed.

4056.title: The judgement of the Watchers, and the blood that filled the earth
4056.summary_md: Michael says what the judgement of the angels is for: *And I heard Michael answering and saying: ‘This judgement wherewith the angels are judged is a testimony for the kings and the mighty who possess the earth.’* (1 Enoch 67:12). The angels' own petition had told heaven how the corruption came: *Thou seest what Azâzêl hath done, who hath taught all unrighteousness on earth and revealed the eternal secrets which were (preserved) in heaven, which men were striving to learn:* (1 Enoch 9:6), *And they have gone to the daughters of men upon the earth, and have slept with the women, and have defiled themselves, and revealed to them all kinds of sins.* (1 Enoch 9:8), *And the women have borne giants, and the whole earth has thereby been filled with blood and unrighteousness.* (1 Enoch 9:9). The Holy One says the same thing to the Watchers' faces: *And though ye were holy, spiritual, living the eternal life, you have defiled yourselves with the blood of women, and have begotten (children) with the blood of flesh, and, as the children of men, have lusted after flesh and blood as those also do who die and perish.* (1 Enoch 15:4). An earth filled with blood is the canon's own flood world: *The earth also was corrupt before Elohim (God), and the earth was filled with violence* (Genesis 6:11), *for the earth is filled with violence through them* (Genesis 6:13). Jubilees tells it the same way: *And every one sold himself to work iniquity and to shed much blood, and the earth was filled with iniquity* (Jubilees 7:23). And the cry of the slain that goes up to heaven is the cry under the altar in the Revelation: *I saw under the altar the souls of them that were slain for the word of Elohim (God)... And they cried with a loud voice, saying, How long, O Yahuah (Lord), holy and true, dost thou not judge and avenge our blood on them that dwell on the earth?* (Revelation 6:9-10). The answer is the one the third Parable closes on: *With chains shall they be bound, And in their assemblage-place of destruction shall they be imprisoned, And all their works vanish from the face of the earth.* (1 Enoch 69:28). The ones who filled the earth with blood are bound, and the ones whose blood was shed are answered.
4056.note: 69:36-39 numbering was the corrupt text; re-quoted live 9:6, 9:8-9 (from the re-anchor), 15:4, 67:12, 69:28; canon kept; title adjusted.

4060.title: Where the first fathers and the righteous dwell
4060.summary_md: Enoch is taken up, and the place he is set down in has the first fathers already living in it: *And from that day I was no longer numbered amongst them: and he set me between the two winds, between the North and the West, where the angels took the cords to measure for me the place for the elect and righteous.* (1 Enoch 70:3), *And there I saw the first fathers and the righteous who from the beginning dwell in that place.* (1 Enoch 70:4). The apostolic writings name that same gathering, the fathers and the righteous made perfect in the heavenly city: *But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living Elohim (God), the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels,* (Hebrews 12:22), *To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to Elohim (God) the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect,* (Hebrews 12:23). The Gospel shows the righteous dead carried to the same rest by angels: *And it came to pass, that the beggar died, and was carried by the angels into Abraham's bosom: the rich man also died, and was buried;* (Luke 16:22). The first fathers do not pass into nothing. The righteous whose names are written in heaven from the beginning dwell in the place Enoch was allowed to see, and the angels measure that place out with cords for the elect; it is prepared for them before they ever arrive.
4060.note: 70:5-7 do not exist (the live chapter is four verses); re-quoted live 70:3-4; Hebrews and Luke kept.

4064.title: The dwelling with the Son of Adam, and the righteous who are not separated from him
4064.summary_md: When Enoch's spirit is carried into the heaven of heavens he sees the house of fire and the ones who guard it: *And round about were Seraphin, Cherubin, and Ophannin: And these are they who sleep not And guard the throne of His glory.* (1 Enoch 71:7), *And I saw angels who could not be counted, A thousand thousands, and ten thousand times ten thousand, Encircling that house. And Michael, and Raphael, and Gabriel, and Phanuel, And the holy angels who are above the heavens, Go in and out of that house.* (1 Enoch 71:8). But the chapter does not end with the angels. It ends with the righteous, and where they will live: *And all shall walk in his ways since righteousness never forsaketh him: With him will be their dwelling-places, and with him their heritage, And they shall not be separated from him for ever and ever and ever.* (1 Enoch 71:16), *And so there shall be length of days with that Son of Adam, And the righteous shall have peace and an upright way In the name of Yahuah (Lord) of Spirits for ever and ever.’* (1 Enoch 71:17). Enoch had just been set down among the first fathers in that same place: *And there I saw the first fathers and the righteous who from the beginning dwell in that place.* (1 Enoch 70:4), and earlier in the Parables he had seen their resting places and longed to stay: *Here mine eyes saw their dwellings with His righteous angels, And their resting-places with the holy. And they petitioned and interceded and prayed for the children of men, And righteousness flowed before them as water, And mercy like dew upon the earth: Thus it is amongst them for ever and ever.* (1 Enoch 39:5). This is the company the letter to the Hebrews names as the destination of the redeemed: *But ye are come unto mount Sion, and unto the city of the living Elohim (God), the heavenly Jerusalem, and to an innumerable company of angels, To the general assembly and church of the firstborn, which are written in heaven, and to Elohim (God) the Judge of all, and to the spirits of just men made perfect* (Hebrews 12:22-23). The first fathers are the line of the covenant people gathered home to the Son of Adam, and their heritage is with him and never apart from him.
4064.note: 71:7 was quoted in invented words and 39:6-7 was invented; re-formed on live 71:7-8, 71:16-17, 70:4, 39:5; Hebrews kept; degraded 'framework' line removed; title adjusted.

4065.title: The secrets of the ends of the heaven — the chambers of the luminaries shown to Enoch
4065.summary_md: Before Enoch sees the Head of Days, Michael takes him by the hand and shows him the hidden order of the heavens: *And the angel Michael [one of the archangels] seized me by my right hand, And lifted me up and led me forth into all the secrets, And he showed me all the secrets of righteousness.* (1 Enoch 71:3), *And he showed me all the secrets of the ends of the heaven, And all the chambers of all the stars, and all the luminaries, Whence they proceed before the face of the holy ones.* (1 Enoch 71:4). The chambers the lights go out from are the canon's own picture of how the Creator governs his world, the very thing Yahuah challenges Job to say he has seen: *Hast thou entered into the treasures of the snow? or hast thou seen the treasures of the hail* (Job 38:22). Jeremiah names the wind drawn out of those same chambers: *When he uttereth his voice, there is a multitude of waters in the heavens, and he causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings with rain, and bringeth forth the wind out of his treasures* (Jeremiah 10:13). And the same hand that keeps the storehouses appoints the lights, which is the order the book of the Luminaries will lay out next: *He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down* (Psalms 104:19). The hidden things Michael shows Enoch are nothing like the secret arts the Watchers sold to men. They are the Creator's own measured order, the stars and the lights and the winds each coming out of the chamber set for it.
4065.note: 71:8 'storehouses of the winds' was invented; re-formed on live 71:3-4 (the secrets of the ends of heaven); Job, Jeremiah, Psalm kept; title adjusted.

4351.title: The great luminary: the sun's rising, its chariot, and its circuit
4351.summary_md: Enoch watches the sun go out first and traces its whole course through the portals: *And this is the first law of the luminaries: the luminary the Sun has its rising in the eastern portals of the heaven, and its setting in the western portals of the heaven.* (1 Enoch 72:2), *And first there goes forth the great luminary, named the Sun, and his circumference is like the circumference of the heaven, and he is quite filled with illuminating and heating fire.* (1 Enoch 72:4), *The chariot on which he ascends, the wind drives, and the sun goes down from the heaven and returns through the north in order to reach the east, and is so guided that he comes to the appropriate (lit. ‘that’) portal and shines in the face of the heaven.* (1 Enoch 72:5). Genesis had already crowned this greater light: *And Elohim (God) made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also* (Genesis 1:16). And David sings the same daily circuit through the same portals: *In them hath he set a tabernacle for the sun, Which is as a bridegroom coming out of his chamber, and rejoiceth as a strong man to run a race. His going forth is from the end of the heaven, and his circuit unto the ends of it: and there is nothing hid from the heat thereof* (Psalm 19:4–6). Enoch's portal tables are the map of the going forth and the circuit the Psalmist praises, and the chapter closes by saying whose order it is: *And that which (thus) rises is the great luminary, and is so named according to its appearance, according as Yahuah (Lord) commanded.* (1 Enoch 72:36). The sun runs its race the way it does because it was told to.
4351.note: 72:4 was quoted in invented words; re-quoted live 72:2, 72:4-5 and added 72:36; Genesis and Psalm kept.

4354.title: Her light given in measure — the moon, a faithful witness
4354.summary_md: After the sun, Enoch is shown the law of the smaller light: *And after this law I saw another law dealing with the smaller luminary, which is named the Moon.* (1 Enoch 73:1), *And her circumference is like the circumference of the heaven, and her chariot in which she rides is driven by the wind, and light is given to her in (definite) measure.* (1 Enoch 73:2), *And her rising and setting change every month: and her days are like the days of the sun, and when her light is uniform (i.e. full) it amounts to the seventh part of the light of the sun.* (1 Enoch 73:3). Her light is given to her in measure, a seventh part at a time, and her first thin phase comes up with the sun on the thirtieth morning and fills out part by part from there. That regularity, month after month without a miss, is what makes her in Scripture a pledge that a covenant will hold: *It shall be established for ever as the moon, and as a faithful witness in heaven. Selah.* (Psalm 89:37). The sage of the Apocrypha reads her the same way, as the appointed sign of the times: *He made the moon also to serve in her season for a declaration of times, and a sign of the world.* (Ecclesiasticus 43:6). The moon's reckoning never breaks because her light is measured out to her by the one who made her, and to keep the reckoning she keeps is to keep faith with him.
4354.note: 73:3-4 quotes were invented; re-quoted live 73:1-3 (light given in measure); Psalm and Sirach kept; title adjusted.

4356.title: Uriel shows the moon's course — the lights for signs and seasons
4356.summary_md: Enoch is shown the moon's whole circuit by the angel who leads all the lights, and he writes down what he is shown: *And I saw another course, a law for her, (and) how according to that law she performs her monthly revolution.* (1 Enoch 74:1), *And all these Uriel, the holy angel who is the leader of them all, showed to me, and their positions, and I wrote down their positions as he showed them to me, and I wrote down their months as they were, and the appearance of their lights till fifteen days were accomplished.* (1 Enoch 74:2), *In single seventh parts she accomplishes all her light in the east, and in single seventh parts accomplishes all her darkness in the west.* (1 Enoch 74:3). None of this is a new cosmology. It is the fourth day of creation unfolded: *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:* (Genesis 1:14). The appointed times are written into the sky by the lights themselves. The Psalmist says the moon's reckoning is the Creator's own appointment and not something men came up with: *He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.* (Psalm 104:19), and the heavens are not quiet about whose work it is: *The heavens declare the glory of Elohim (God); and the firmament sheweth his handywork.* (Psalm 19:1). Enoch only spells out, portal by portal, what Genesis set in the sky and the Psalms confess. It ain't new.
4356.note: 74:1 was quoted in invented words; re-quoted live 74:1-3; Genesis and Psalms kept.

4357.title: The sun and the stars complete the year in 364 days
4357.summary_md: Here the book of the Luminaries states the reckoning plainly, and shows where the moon falls short of it: *And if five years are added together the sun has an overplus of thirty days, and all the days which accrue to it for one of those five years, when they are full, amount to 364 days.* (1 Enoch 74:10), *And the overplus of the sun and of the stars amounts to six days: in 5 years 6 days every year come to 30 days: and the moon falls behind the sun and stars to the number of 30 days.* (1 Enoch 74:11), *And the sun and the stars bring in all the years exactly, so that they do not advance or delay their position by a single day unto eternity; but complete the years with perfect justice in 364 days.* (1 Enoch 74:12). The same number is sealed later in the book: *For they belong to the reckoning of the year and are truly recorded (thereon) for ever, one in the first portal and one in the third, and one in the fourth and one in the sixth, and the year is completed in three hundred and sixty-four days.* (1 Enoch 82:6). This is the order of whole days Genesis sets up when the lights are given for *days, and years* (Genesis 1:14). Jubilees guards the very same number and warns against letting the moon set the feasts: *For there will be those who will assuredly make observations of the moon–now (it) disturbs the seasons and comes in from year to year ten days too soon.* (Jubilees 6:36), and so that the feasts do not drift it commands the fixed count: *...so that they will not make the year three hundred and sixty-four days only, and for this reason they will go wrong as to the new moons and seasons and sabbaths and festivals...* (Jubilees 6:37). The sun and the stars carry the year; the moon is read against them, and six days a year she falls behind.
4357.note: 74:10-12 were quoted in invented words; re-quoted live 74:10-12 and 82:6; Genesis and Jubilees kept; title adjusted (the live verses credit the sun and stars).

4358.title: With perfect justice in 364 days — the feasts kept on time
4358.summary_md: The chapter's reckoning ends on faithfulness rather than arithmetic: *And the sun and the stars bring in all the years exactly, so that they do not advance or delay their position by a single day unto eternity; but complete the years with perfect justice in 364 days.* (1 Enoch 74:12), *And the year is accurately completed in conformity with their world- stations and the stations of the sun, which rise from the portals through which it (the sun) rises and sets 30 days.* (1 Enoch 74:17). The lights do not advance or delay by a single day, and the whole point of that is so the appointed times arrive when they are supposed to. The feasts of Yahuah are fixed by the lights he set, not by men: *These are the feasts of Yahuah (LORD), even holy convocations, which ye shall proclaim in their seasons.* (Leviticus 23:4). Jubilees seals it with the warning that the division of days is written on the heavenly tables for exactly this reason: *...for the book (lies) written before me, and on the heavenly tables the division of days is ordained, lest they forget the feasts of the covenant and walk according to the feasts of the nations after their error and after their ignorance.* (Jubilees 6:35). To complete the years with perfect justice is to keep faith with the one who ordered them, and to keep his reckoning is to keep his appointed times. It ain't new.
4358.note: 74:13 was invented; re-formed on live 74:12 and 74:17; Leviticus and Jubilees kept; title adjusted.

4359.title: The sun and the stars do not change their order — against the one who thinks to change times
4359.summary_md: Uriel closes the reckoning of the sun and the moon with a plain statement about what the lights will and will not do: *And the sun and the stars bring in all the years exactly, so that they do not advance or delay their position by a single day unto eternity; but complete the years with perfect justice in 364 days.* (1 Enoch 74:12). The lights keep the order they were given, and Enoch wrote it down so that his children would keep it too. He also saw where the fault would lie when the reckoning went wrong, and it was never with the heavens: *Owing to them men shall be at fault and not reckon them in the whole reckoning of the year: yea, men shall be at fault, and not recognize them accurately.* (1 Enoch 82:5). Daniel was shown the one who would make a program of that fault, the horn that wars on the saints: *And he shall speak great words against the El Elyon (most High), and shall wear out the saints of the El Elyon (most High), and think to change times and laws: and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.* (Daniel 7:25). To change the times is to fight the Creator's own order, and the Torah had already warned that the lights are servants of the appointed times and never gods, never men's to re-order: *And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them...* (Deuteronomy 4:19). Against all of it stands the blessing Enoch pronounces on those who keep the count as the sun keeps it: *Blessed are all the righteous, blessed are all those who walk in the way of righteousness and sin not as the sinners, in the reckoning of all their days in which the sun traverses the heaven, entering into and departing from the portals for thirty days with the heads of thousands of the order of the stars, together with the four which are intercalated which divide the four portions of the year, which lead them and enter with them four days.* (1 Enoch 82:4). The order is covenant, and the sun has never once broken it.
4359.note: All three Enoch quotes were invented; re-formed on 74:12, 82:5 and 82:4, which carry the same thought. Daniel 7:25 and Deuteronomy 4:19 kept verbatim. Title adjusted to the live verse.

4360.title: The leaders set over the seasons — the moedim written into creation
4360.summary_md: Enoch sees an ordered hierarchy of luminary-captains set over every division of time: *And the leaders of the heads of the thousands, who are placed over the whole creation and over all the stars, have also to do with the four intercalary days, being inseparable from their office, according to the reckoning of the year, and these render service on the four days which are not reckoned in the reckoning of the year.* (1 Enoch 75:1). Uriel is set over the whole company of them, *For the signs and the times and the years and the days the angel Uriel showed to me, whom Yahuah (Lord) of glory hath set for ever over all the luminaries of the heaven, in the heaven and in the world, that they should rule on the face of the heaven and be seen on the earth, and be leaders for the day and the night, i.e. the sun, moon, and stars, and all the ministering creatures which make their revolution in all the chariots of the heaven.* (1 Enoch 75:3). This is no invention of Enoch's; it is the Creator's own order from the fourth day, when the lights were set to mark out the times: *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:* (Genesis 1:14). The feasts of Leviticus 23 are therefore fixed by the luminaries and not declared by men. The Psalmist names the same governance, *He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.* (Psalms 104:19), and earthly Yashar'el (Israel) mirrored the heavenly ranks in the priestly *courses, which came in and went out month by month throughout all the months of the year* (1 Chronicles 27:1). The stars themselves are summoned to bless the One who set them: *He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.* (Psalms 148:6). The appointed times are the Creator's covenant order, and it ain't new.
4360.note: Draft's 75:1 quote stood; the inline '75:2–75:6' phrase-citations (the four parts, the seven days, the months…) were not in the live chapter, so replaced with 75:3 quoted in full. Rest kept.

4361.title: The four intercalary days that complete the 364-day year
4361.summary_md: Here is the heart of the Enoch reckoning, the part of the solar order men most often neglect: *And the leaders of the heads of the thousands, who are placed over the whole creation and over all the stars, have also to do with the four intercalary days, being inseparable from their office, according to the reckoning of the year, and these render service on the four days which are not reckoned in the reckoning of the year.* (1 Enoch 75:1). Enoch says outright that these four days are where the count goes wrong, and where the true year is completed: *And owing to them men go wrong therein, for those luminaries truly render service on the world-stations, one in the first portal, one in the third portal of the heaven, one in the fourth portal, and one in the sixth portal, and the exactness of the year is accomplished through its separate three hundred and sixty-four stations.* (1 Enoch 75:2). Jubilees gives the very same command, with the very same warning that men would drop these days: *And command you the children of Yashar'el (Israel) that they observe the years according to this reckoning-three hundred and sixty-four days, and (these) will constitute a complete year, and they will not disturb its time from its days and from its feasts; for everything will fall out in them according to their testimony, and they will not leave out any day nor disturb any feasts. But if they do neglect and do not observe them according to His commandment, then they will disturb all their seasons, and the years will be dislodged from this (order), and they will disturb the seasons and the years will be dislodged and they will neglect their ordinances.* (Jubilees 6:32), and the reckoning is written down *lest they forget the feasts of the covenant and walk according to the feasts of the nations* (Jubilees 6:35). The year of three hundred and sixty-four whole days, completed by these four added days, is the Creator's calendar, and to leave them out is to dislodge the feasts. Genesis had already set the lights *for seasons, and for days, and years* (Genesis 1:14), and the appointed times of Leviticus 23 hang on that order.
4361.note: Old inline citations 75:11-13 (the four names, '364 days') are not in the live chapter; replaced with 75:2 in full, which carries both the men-go-wrong warning and the 364 stations. Jubilees and Genesis kept verbatim.

4362.title: The sun and the stars complete the year with perfect justice — covenant order in the heavens
4362.summary_md: The reckoning of the heavens ends on the obedience of the lights: *And the sun and the stars bring in all the years exactly, so that they do not advance or delay their position by a single day unto eternity; but complete the years with perfect justice in 364 days.* (1 Enoch 74:12). The sun has an exactness of its own that Enoch is careful to record: *And the year is accurately completed in conformity with their world- stations and the stations of the sun, which rise from the portals through which it (the sun) rises and sets 30 days.* (1 Enoch 74:17). This is the same testimony the book opened with, before a single vision was given: *Observe ye everything that takes place in the heaven, how they do not change their orbits, and the luminaries which are in the heaven, how they all rise and set in order each in its season, and transgress not against their appointed order.* (1 Enoch 2:1). It is the covenant the prophets appeal to as the surest thing in creation, *Thus saith Yahuah (LORD); If my covenant be not with day and night, and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth;* (Jeremiah 33:25), an ordinance so fixed it cannot be broken: *He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.* (Psalms 148:6). The lights keeping their law is the standing rebuke to men who would change the times. Where the sun never once delays its station, the order it traces out is the Creator's covenant and not a burden laid on anyone, and the heavens keep the reckoning so faithfully that men are called to keep it the same way.
4362.note: 75:15 does not exist in Charles; the thought lives at 74:12 and 74:17 — re-formed there. 2:1, Jeremiah 33:25, Psalm 148:6 kept. Title adjusted to the live wording.

4363.title: Twelve portals at the ends of the earth — the winds in their treasuries
4363.summary_md: Uriel shows Enoch the order at the world's edge: *And at the ends of the earth I saw twelve portals open to all the quarters (of the heaven), from which the winds go forth and blow over the earth.* (1 Enoch 76:1). They are laid out by quarter, not scattered at random: *Three of them are open on the face (i.e. the east) of the heavens, and three in the west, and three on the right (i.e. the south) of the heaven, and three on the left (i.e. the north).* (1 Enoch 76:2). The winds come out of appointed gates by the Creator's reckoning, and the Tanakh confesses the same honest geography: *He causeth the vapours to ascend from the ends of the earth; he maketh lightnings for the rain; he bringeth the wind out of his treasuries* (Psalm 135:7). The wind is kept in a treasury and brought out by Yahuah's (God's) hand, never summoned by men. Job hears the order spoken from the same edge of creation: *By what way is the light parted, which scattereth the east wind upon the earth?* (Job 38:24). The lights of Genesis 1 were set *for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years* (Genesis 1:14), and the winds keep their stations in the same way, the Creator's covenant order written into the world. Jubilees names the angels set over these powers on the first day: *and the angels of the spirit of the winds, and the angels of the spirit of the clouds, and of darkness, and of snow and of hail and of hoar frost... and the angels of the spirits of cold and of heat* (Jubilees 2:2). The gates, the treasuries and the appointed winds are one order under one Maker.
4363.note: The 76:1 quote was a blend of 36:1 and 76:1; replaced with the live 76:1 and 76:2 in full. Canon and Jubilees witnesses kept verbatim.

4364.title: Winds of blessing and prosperity, winds of desolation and drought
4364.summary_md: The twelve portals are not all alike, and Enoch is told plainly which are which: *Through four of these come winds of blessing and prosperity, and from those eight come hurtful winds: when they are sent, they bring destruction on all the earth and on the water upon it, and on all who dwell thereon, and on everything which is in the water and on the land.* (1 Enoch 76:4). The first of them is named with its charge, *And the first wind from those portals, called the east wind, comes forth through the first portal which is in the east, inclining towards the south: from it come forth desolation, drought, heat, and destruction.* (1 Enoch 76:5), and the middle gate beside it carries the opposite: *And through the second portal in the middle comes what is fitting, and from it there come rain and fruitfulness and prosperity and dew; and through the third portal which lies toward the north come cold and drought.* (1 Enoch 76:6). So the winds are sorted to blessing and to hurt, dew and rain on one hand and drought and desolation on the other, which are exactly the two roads the covenant sets before a people. Job knows this sorting by quarter too: *Out of the south cometh the whirlwind: and cold out of the north* (Job 37:9). The directions are not neutral; they are assigned. The whole order stands under one Maker, and the withholding of rain is never arbitrary but follows a broken covenant, while the dew and the rain are the blessing-wind brought out of His treasuries. Enoch is shown the whole catalogue so the reckoning can be kept, not so men might control the sky.
4364.note: Both Enoch quotes were off (76:4 reworded, 76:5 invented); re-formed on the live 76:4, 76:5 and 76:6. Job 37:9 kept.

4365.title: The twelve completed — the four winds from the four quarters
4365.summary_md: Uriel closes the survey: *And the twelve portals of the four quarters of the heaven are therewith completed, and all their laws and all their plagues and all their benefactions have I shown to thee, my son Methuselah.* (1 Enoch 76:14). Twelve gates resolve into the four cardinal quarters, and each wind bears its law, its plague, and its benefaction. The prophets reckon by these same four quarters when Yahuah (God) moves in judgment: *And upon Elam will I bring the four winds from the four quarters of heaven, and will scatter them toward all those winds* (Jeremiah 49:36). Daniel's vision opens on the same fourfold order stirred over the deep: *I saw in my vision by night, and, behold, the four winds of the heaven strove upon the great sea* (Daniel 7:2). The winds out of which the beast-kingdoms rise are the very ordered powers Enoch catalogues. They keep their stations under the Creator; their laws and their plagues alike are His to send, and reading the order rightly is part of keeping the covenant reckoning.
4365.note: Draft's live 76:14 quote already fit the prose (it speaks of portals and laws/plagues/benefactions); only light smoothing of the connecting sentences.

4367.title: The garden of righteousness in the north — the tree of wisdom
4367.summary_md: When Enoch names the four quarters he places the garden in the north: *And the fourth quarter, named the north, is divided into three parts: the first of them is for the dwelling of men: and the second contains seas of water, and the abysses and forests and rivers, and darkness and clouds; and the third part contains the garden of righteousness.* (1 Enoch 77:3). He had already walked in it on an earlier journey and seen the tree that stands there: *That tree is in height like the fir, and its leaves are like (those of) the Carob tree: and its fruit is like the clusters of the vine, very beautiful: and the fragrance of the tree penetrates afar.* (1 Enoch 32:4). This is Eden's own garden: *And out of the ground made Yahuah Elohim (the LORD God) to grow every tree that is pleasant to the sight, and good for food; the tree of life also in the midst of the garden, and the tree of knowledge of good and evil.* (Genesis 2:9). The garden of righteousness is not lost forever. The tree of life stands again in the restored city, *In the midst of the street of it, and on either side of the river, was there the tree of life, which bare twelve manner of fruits, and yielded her fruit every month: and the leaves of the tree were for the healing of the nations.* (Revelation 22:2), and Ezekiel saw it lining the river from the sanctuary: *And by the river upon the bank thereof, on this side and on that side, shall grow all trees for meat, whose leaf shall not fade, neither shall the fruit thereof be consumed: it shall bring forth new fruit according to his months, because their waters they issued out of the sanctuary: and the fruit thereof shall be for meat, and the leaf thereof for medicine.* (Ezekiel 47:12). Enoch's garden in the north is the canon's Eden, lost and restored.
4367.note: 77:7 'paradise of righteousness... tree of wisdom' is invented; the live 77:3 carries the garden of righteousness in the north. 32:4 (already re-quoted from the live text) kept; Genesis 3:7 dropped since the 'eyes opened' phrase it answered is gone. Title adjusted.

4368.title: The prison of the stars that did not come forth at their appointed times
4368.summary_md: Past the abyss Enoch sees a waste place that has become a prison for the host of heaven: *I saw there seven stars like great burning mountains, and to me, when I inquired regarding them, The angel said: ‘This place is the end of heaven and earth: this has become a prison for the stars and the host of heaven.* (1 Enoch 18:13-14). The charge against them is precise, and it is a calendar charge: *And the stars which roll over the fire are they which have transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (Lord) in the beginning of their rising, because they did not come forth at their appointed times.* (1 Enoch 18:15). They broke the appointed times that were set into the lights on the fourth day: *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:* (Genesis 1:14). Enoch is shown the same prisoners a second time, and Uriel gives the same reason: *These are of the number of the stars of heaven, which have transgressed the commandment of Yahuah (Lord), and are bound here till ten thousand years, the time entailed by their sins, are consummated.’* (1 Enoch 21:6). The apostles carry the same bound and reserved host forward, *For if Elohim (God) spared not the angels that sinned, but cast them down to hell, and delivered them into chains of darkness, to be reserved unto judgment;* (2 Peter 2:4), and Jude names them as the lawless lights: *Raging waves of the sea, foaming out their own shame; wandering stars, to whom is reserved the blackness of darkness for ever.* (Jude 1:13). These are the same lights men are warned never to worship as gods: *And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.* (Deuteronomy 4:19). The reckoning is the Creator's covenant, and Jubilees commands the very order whose neglect disturbs every feast: *And command you the children of Yashar'el (Israel) that they observe the years according to this reckoning-three hundred and sixty-four days, and (these) will constitute a complete year, and they will not disturb its time from its days and from its feasts...* (Jubilees 6:32). The stars in prison are what a perverted calendar looks like from heaven's side; the right reckoning is faithfulness, and it ain't new.
4368.note: The old 77:10-11 addresses do not exist; the words live at 18:13-15 and 21:6. Removed the duplicated 18:15 quote the mechanical pass produced and put 21:6 in its place. Canon witnesses kept.

4369.title: The names of the sun and moon — the two great lights
4369.summary_md: Enoch gives the luminaries their names: *And the names of the sun are the following: the first Orjârês, and the second Tômâs.* (1 Enoch 78:1), *And the moon has four names: the first name is Asônjâ, the second Eblâ, the third Benâsê, and the fourth Erâe.* (1 Enoch 78:2), and then he says what they are together: *These are the two great luminaries: their circumference is like the circumference of the heaven, and the size of the circumference of both is alike.* (1 Enoch 78:3). This is creation week itself: *And Elohim (God) made two great lights; the greater light to rule the day, and the lesser light to rule the night: he made the stars also* (Genesis 1:16). The naming is not an idle catalogue. It is the order the heavens keep, so that they can sing it back to the One who set them: *Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light* (Psalm 148:3), for *he commanded, and they were created* (Psalm 148:5). The lights belong to the Creator and carry His reckoning; they are servants set in their stations, never powers to be feared or worshipped.
4369.note: Both Enoch quotes were invented; re-formed on the live 78:1-3, which carry the names and 'the two great luminaries'. Canon kept.

4370.title: The 364-day solar reckoning — the moon falls behind
4370.summary_md: Enoch sets the sun as the measure of the year, and he is exact about it: *And the sun and the stars bring in all the years exactly, so that they do not advance or delay their position by a single day unto eternity; but complete the years with perfect justice in 364 days.* (1 Enoch 74:12). The moon does not keep that pace. Her year is counted in two halves of one hundred and seventy-seven days, *And three months she makes of thirty days, and at her time she makes three months of twenty-nine days each, in which she accomplishes her waning in the first period of time, and in the first portal for one hundred and seventy-seven days.* (1 Enoch 78:15), and Uriel adds up what that costs her against the sun: *And the overplus of the sun and of the stars amounts to six days: in 5 years 6 days every year come to 30 days: and the moon falls behind the sun and stars to the number of 30 days.* (1 Enoch 74:11). That gap is the whole point. The lunar count runs behind the solar order, so the reckoning is fixed by the sun. Jubilees lays the same charge on Yashar'el (Israel): *command you the children of Yashar'el (Israel) that they observe the years according to this reckoning-three hundred and sixty-four days, and (these) will constitute a complete year, and they will not disturb its time from its days and from its feasts* (Jubilees 6:32). The year of three hundred and sixty-four whole days is the Creator's calendar, set on the fourth day, and the appointed times stand or fall by it. Keeping that reckoning is covenant faithfulness and not a later invention of men.
4370.note: The old 78:4-5 and 74:10,13 quotes were invented; the live 74:12, 74:11 and 78:15 carry the 364-day sun and the moon falling behind. Jubilees kept.

4371.title: Her light waxes and wanes — the new moon appointed for worship
4371.summary_md: Enoch measures the moon's fullness part by part: *And when the moon rises one-fourteenth part appears in the heaven: [the light becomes full in her]: on the fourteenth day she accomplishes her light.* (1 Enoch 78:6), and he names the first day of the count: *And on the first day she is called the new moon, for on that day the light rises upon her.* (1 Enoch 78:12). The waxing and the waning are not chaos; they are appointment, and the moon is set for the times Yashar'el (Israel) keeps. So the Psalm fixes the trumpet to her renewal, *Blow up the trumpet in the new moon, in the time appointed, on our solemn feast day* (Psalm 81:3), and the prophet sees worship itself ordered by that cycle: *it shall come to pass, that from one new moon to another, and from one sabbath to another, shall all flesh come to worship before me, saith Yahuah (LORD)* (Isaiah 66:23). The phases Enoch reckons are the Creator's clock for the appointed times. The new moon is written into the light itself, and keeping it is covenant worship.
4371.note: 78:6 was invented; the live 78:6 and 78:12 carry the waxing count and the naming of the new moon. Psalm 81:3 and Isaiah 66:23 kept.

4372.title: The law of the moon's light — set for signs and seasons
4372.summary_md: Uriel does not leave the moon's course to guesswork; he gives Enoch its law: *And Uriel showed me another law: when light is transferred to the moon, and on which side it is transferred to her by the sun.* (1 Enoch 78:10), and he fixes the day the count begins: *And on the first day she is called the new moon, for on that day the light rises upon her.* (1 Enoch 78:12). The whole reckoning was handed down for the festivals and not for curiosity: *And the account thereof is accurate and the recorded reckoning thereof exact; for the luminaries, and months and festivals, and years and days, has Uriel shown and revealed to me, to whom Yahuah (Lord) of the whole creation of the world hath subjected the host of heaven.* (1 Enoch 82:7). This is the fourth-day charge spoken back: *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years* (Genesis 1:14), where the seasons are the appointed times. The Psalm seals it, *He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down* (Psalm 104:19), and the heavens preach their Maker's order: *The heavens declare the glory of Elohim (God); and the firmament sheweth his handywork* (Psalm 19:1). The lights keep their law, and men are called to keep the reckoning they mark. To neglect or change that order is the work of the one who would *think to change times and laws* (Daniel 7:25), but the Creator's calendar stands, fixed in the lights.
4372.note: The 78:9,11,12 quotes were invented; re-formed on the live 78:10, 78:12 and 82:7 (which names luminaries, months and festivals together). Canon kept. Title adjusted.

4373.title: The law of all the stars completed — the luminaries set for the appointed times
4373.summary_md: Uriel's survey of the heavens ends with a word to Methuselah that the whole thing is law: *And now, my son, I have shown thee everything, and the law of all the stars of the heaven is completed.* (1 Enoch 79:1). What was shown covers every measure of time a people needs to keep the feasts: *And he showed me all the laws of these for every day, and for every season of bearing rule, and for every year, and for its going forth, and for the order prescribed to it every month and every week:* (1 Enoch 79:2). The appointed times were never invented by men. They were written into creation by the lights on the fourth day: *And Elohim (God) said, Let there be lights in the firmament of the heaven to divide the day from the night; and let them be for signs, and for seasons, and for days, and years:* (Genesis 1:14). The same order is sung in the Psalm, *He appointed the moon for seasons: the sun knoweth his going down.* (Psalm 104:19), and it is the very fabric the prophet swears by: *Thus saith Yahuah (LORD), which giveth the sun for a light by day, and the ordinances of the moon and of the stars for a light by night, which divideth the sea when the waves thereof roar; Yahuah Tseva'ot (LORD of hosts) is his name:* (Jeremiah 31:35). The calendar is the Creator's covenant order, and the appointed times stand because the lights stand.
4373.note: 79:3 quote was invented; re-formed on the live 79:1-2. Canon kept. 'It ain't new' dropped from the title since the live verse carries the thought plainly.

4374.title: Every luminary in its order — the host of heaven serve their Maker
4374.summary_md: Enoch signs off the luminaries with the name of the one who showed them to him: *Such is the picture and sketch of every luminary which Uriel the archangel, who is their leader, showed unto me.* (1 Enoch 79:6). The lights are obedient servants under a leader, never powers of their own, and Uriel had already told Enoch how exactly they keep their station: *And the sun and the stars bring in all the years exactly, so that they do not advance or delay their position by a single day unto eternity; but complete the years with perfect justice in 364 days.* (1 Enoch 74:12). They do not stray because *He hath also stablished them for ever and ever: he hath made a decree which shall not pass.* (Psalm 148:6), the very heavens commanded to *Praise ye him, sun and moon: praise him, all ye stars of light.* (Psalm 148:3). Their silent obedience preaches: *The heavens declare the glory of Elohim (God); and the firmament sheweth his handywork.* (Psalm 19:1). And because they keep their order, they become the surety of the covenant itself: *Thus saith Yahuah (LORD); If my covenant be not with day and night, and if I have not appointed the ordinances of heaven and earth;* (Jeremiah 33:25). The hosts serve their Maker, which is exactly why the Torah forbids serving them: *And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.* (Deuteronomy 4:19).
4374.note: 79:4 quote was invented; re-formed on the live 79:6 and 74:12. Canon kept. Title adjusted.

4375.title: The 364-day solar order and the moon falling behind
4375.summary_md: Enoch fixes the primary reckoning by the sun: *And the sun and the stars bring in all the years exactly, so that they do not advance or delay their position by a single day unto eternity; but complete the years with perfect justice in 364 days.* (1 Enoch 74:12). The moon is measured against that and comes up short. Her half-year is counted out, *And the waning which takes place in the first portal in its season, till one hundred and seventy-seven days are accomplished: reckoned according to weeks, twenty-five (weeks) and two days.* (1 Enoch 79:4), and then the lag is named: *She falls behind the sun and the order of the stars exactly five days in the course of one period, and when this place which thou seest has been traversed.* (1 Enoch 79:5). Uriel had already summed the same shortfall over the years: *And the overplus of the sun and of the stars amounts to six days: in 5 years 6 days every year come to 30 days: and the moon falls behind the sun and stars to the number of 30 days.* (1 Enoch 74:11). So the solar order is the measure and the lunar year lags behind it. Jubilees commands the same three hundred and sixty-four days, with the same diagnosis of the moon: *And command you the children of Yashar'el (Israel) that they observe the years according to this reckoning-three hundred and sixty-four days, and (these) will constitute a complete year, and they will not disturb its time from its days and from its feasts; for everything will fall out in them according to their testimony, and they will not leave out any day nor disturb any feasts.* (Jubilees 6:32), and the very lag Enoch names: *For there will be those who will assuredly make observations of the moon–now (it) disturbs the seasons and comes in from year to year ten days too soon.* (Jubilees 6:36). The whole-day solar order completes the year in righteousness, and it ain't new.
4375.note: All three Enoch quotes were invented; re-formed on the live 74:12, 79:4-5 and 74:11, which carry the 364 days and the moon's lag. Jubilees kept.

4376.title: Preserve the books and keep the reckoning — blessed are those who walk in it
4376.summary_md: The law of the luminaries is handed down to be kept, not catalogued. Enoch gives it to his son with a charge: *And now, my son Methuselah, all these things I am recounting to thee and writing down for thee, and I have revealed to thee everything, and given thee books concerning all these: so preserve, my son Methuselah, the books from thy father’s hand, and (see) that thou deliver them to the generations of the world.* (1 Enoch 82:1), and he says what it is for: *I have given wisdom to thee and to thy children, [And thy children that shall be to thee], That they may give it to their children for generations, This wisdom (namely) that passeth their thought.* (1 Enoch 82:2). The blessing is on those who keep the count as the sun keeps it: *Blessed are all the righteous, blessed are all those who walk in the way of righteousness and sin not as the sinners, in the reckoning of all their days in which the sun traverses the heaven, entering into and departing from the portals for thirty days with the heads of thousands of the order of the stars, together with the four which are intercalated which divide the four portions of the year, which lead them and enter with them four days.* (1 Enoch 82:4). The feasts those years carry are the appointed times the Torah fixes: *Speak unto the children of Yashar'el (Israel), and say unto them, Concerning the feasts of Yahuah (LORD), which ye shall proclaim to be holy convocations, even these are my feasts.* (Leviticus 23:2). When men refuse the order, Daniel shows whose work that is: *And he shall speak great words against the El Elyon (most High), and shall wear out the saints of the El Elyon (most High), and think to change times and laws: and they shall be given into his hand until a time and times and the dividing of time.* (Daniel 7:25). To keep the right reckoning is covenant faithfulness; to change the times is rebellion against the Creator's order.
4376.note: 79:8-10 do not exist and 82:5 was misquoted; re-formed on the live 82:1, 82:2 and 82:4. Leviticus 23:2 and Daniel 7:25 kept. Title adjusted.

4377.title: They shall err and take them to be gods — the host of heaven
4377.summary_md: Uriel tells Enoch what happens to the luminaries in the days of the sinners: *And the moon shall alter her order, And not appear at her time.* (1 Enoch 80:4), and the stars with her: *And many chiefs of the stars shall transgress the order (prescribed). And these shall alter their orbits and tasks, And not appear at the seasons prescribed to them.* (1 Enoch 80:6). When the lights no longer keep their appointed reckoning, men do not return to the Creator who set them. Uriel says exactly where it ends: *And the whole order of the stars shall be concealed from the sinners, And the thoughts of those on the earth shall err concerning them, [And they shall be altered from all their ways], Yea, they shall err and take them to be gods.* (1 Enoch 80:7). That is the very snare Moses warned against on the plains of Moab: *And lest thou lift up thine eyes unto heaven, and when thou seest the sun, and the moon, and the stars, even all the host of heaven, shouldest be driven to worship them, and serve them, which Yahuah Elohayka (the LORD thy God) hath divided unto all nations under the whole heaven.* (Deuteronomy 4:19). Jeremiah names the same apostasy when the bones of the idolaters are spread out before the very host they served: *And they shall spread them before the sun, and the moon, and all the host of heaven, whom they have loved, and whom they have served, and after whom they have walked, and whom they have sought, and whom they have worshipped...* (Jeremiah 8:2). Paul names the root of it, the creature exalted over the Creator: *Who changed the truth of Elohim (God) into a lie, and worshipped and served the creature more than the Creator, who is blessed for ever. Amen.* (Romans 1:25). The sun and moon are servants set for signs and seasons, and taking the servant for the Master is the oldest lie there is.
4377.note: 80:1 quote was invented; the live 80:4, 80:6 and 80:7 carry the thought, 80:7 saying outright that men take the stars for gods. Canon kept. Title adjusted to the live words.
